import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import type {
    AnswerSummary,
    BaselineRegressionReference,
    BaselineRegressionResult,
    RetrievalCaseResult,
    RetrievalSummary,
} from "./types";

const BASELINE_PATH = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../baselines/baseline-rag-v1.json"
);
const DATASET_PATH = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../datasets/reader-rag-golden.jsonl"
);
const FIXTURE_MANIFEST_PATH = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../fixtures/manifest.json"
);
const EPSILON = 1e-12;

const sha256 = (value: Buffer | string) =>
    createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");

const unique = (values: string[]) => new Set(values).size === values.length;

const assertUnitMetric = (name: string, value: unknown) => {
    if (
        typeof value !== "number" ||
        !Number.isFinite(value) ||
        value < 0 ||
        value > 1
    ) {
        throw new Error(`Baseline reference ${name} must be between 0 and 1`);
    }
};

export const validateBaselineReference = (
    value: unknown
): BaselineRegressionReference => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference must be an object");
    }
    const reference = value as BaselineRegressionReference;
    if (reference.schemaVersion !== 1) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference has an unsupported schema version");
    }
    if (
        !reference.referenceVersion ||
        !reference.pipelineVersion ||
        !reference.promptVersion
    ) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference identity is incomplete");
    }
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(reference.datasetSha256)) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference dataset SHA-256 is invalid");
    }
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(reference.fixtureManifestSha256)) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference fixture SHA-256 is invalid");
    }
    if (
        !Array.isArray(reference.requiredCaseIds) ||
        reference.requiredCaseIds.length !== 7 ||
        !unique(reference.requiredCaseIds)
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Baseline reference must contain seven unique required case IDs"
        );
    }
    if (
        !Array.isArray(reference.answerModels) ||
        reference.answerModels.length !== 3 ||
        !unique(reference.answerModels)
    ) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference must contain three answer models");
    }
    if (reference.judgedAnswerCount !== 21) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference must require 21 judged answers");
    }
    assertUnitMetric(
        "answerMetricTolerance",
        reference.answerMetricTolerance
    );
    for (const [name, metric] of Object.entries(reference.retrieval)) {
        if (metric !== null) assertUnitMetric(`retrieval.${name}`, metric);
    }
    for (const [name, metric] of Object.entries(reference.answers)) {
        assertUnitMetric(`answers.${name}`, metric);
    }
    if (
        !Array.isArray(reference.cases) ||
        reference.cases.length !== reference.requiredCaseIds.length ||
        !unique(reference.cases.map((testCase) => testCase.id)) ||
        !reference.requiredCaseIds.every((id) =>
            reference.cases.some((testCase) => testCase.id === id)
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference case snapshots do not match IDs");
    }
    if (
        !Array.isArray(reference.knownGaps) ||
        !unique(reference.knownGaps.map((gap) => gap.caseId)) ||
        !reference.knownGaps.every((gap) =>
            reference.requiredCaseIds.includes(gap.caseId)
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error("Baseline reference known gaps are invalid");
    }
    return reference;
};

export const loadBaselineReference = async (
    filePath = BASELINE_PATH
): Promise<BaselineRegressionReference> =>
    validateBaselineReference(JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf8")));

export const computeBaselineInputHashes = async ({
    datasetPath = DATASET_PATH,
    fixtureManifestPath = FIXTURE_MANIFEST_PATH,
}: {
    datasetPath?: string;
    fixtureManifestPath?: string;
} = {}) => ({
    datasetSha256: sha256(await fs.readFile(datasetPath)),
    fixtureManifestSha256: sha256(await fs.readFile(fixtureManifestPath)),
});

const equalSets = (left: string[], right: string[]) =>
    left.length === right.length &&
    left.every((value) => right.includes(value));

const atLeast = (actual: number, expected: number) =>
    actual + EPSILON >= expected;
const atMost = (actual: number, expected: number) =>
    actual <= expected + EPSILON;

export const evaluateBaselineRegression = ({
    reference,
    datasetSha256,
    fixtureManifestSha256,
    pipelineVersions,
    promptVersions,
    answerModels,
    judgeModel,
    retrieval,
    answers,
}: {
    reference: BaselineRegressionReference;
    datasetSha256: string;
    fixtureManifestSha256: string;
    pipelineVersions: string[];
    promptVersions: string[];
    answerModels: string[];
    judgeModel: string;
    retrieval: { summary: RetrievalSummary; cases: RetrievalCaseResult[] };
    answers: { summary: AnswerSummary; cases: unknown[] };
}): BaselineRegressionResult => {
    const checks: Record<string, boolean> = {
        datasetSha256Matches: datasetSha256 === reference.datasetSha256,
        fixtureManifestSha256Matches:
            fixtureManifestSha256 === reference.fixtureManifestSha256,
        pipelineMatches:
            pipelineVersions.length === 1 &&
            pipelineVersions[0] === reference.pipelineVersion,
        promptMatches:
            promptVersions.length === 1 &&
            promptVersions[0] === reference.promptVersion,
        answerModelsMatch: equalSets(answerModels, reference.answerModels),
        judgeModelMatches: judgeModel === reference.judgeModel,
        judgedAnswerCountMatches:
            answers.cases.length === reference.judgedAnswerCount,
        requiredCasesMatch: equalSets(
            retrieval.cases.map((testCase) => testCase.id),
            reference.requiredCaseIds
        ),
        recallAtKNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.recallAtK,
            reference.retrieval.recallAtK
        ),
        evidenceCoverageNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.evidenceCoverage,
            reference.retrieval.evidenceCoverage
        ),
        mrrNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.mrr,
            reference.retrieval.mrr
        ),
        sourceHitRateNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.sourceHitRate,
            reference.retrieval.sourceHitRate
        ),
        vectorSourceHitRateNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.vectorSourceHitRate,
            reference.retrieval.vectorSourceHitRate
        ),
        vectorMrrNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.vectorMrr,
            reference.retrieval.vectorMrr
        ),
        vectorIdAlignmentRateNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.vectorIdAlignmentRate,
            reference.retrieval.vectorIdAlignmentRate
        ),
        chunkWindowHitRateNonRegression: atLeast(
            retrieval.summary.chunkWindowHitRate,
            reference.retrieval.chunkWindowHitRate
        ),
        chapterAccuracyNonRegression:
            retrieval.summary.chapterAccuracy !== null &&
            reference.retrieval.chapterAccuracy !== null &&
            atLeast(
                retrieval.summary.chapterAccuracy,
                reference.retrieval.chapterAccuracy
            ),
        groundednessWithinBudget: atLeast(
            answers.summary.groundedness,
            reference.answers.groundedness - reference.answerMetricTolerance
        ),
        citationCoverageWithinBudget: atLeast(
            answers.summary.citationCoverage,
            reference.answers.citationCoverage -
                reference.answerMetricTolerance
        ),
        refusalCorrectnessWithinBudget: atLeast(
            answers.summary.refusalCorrectness,
            reference.answers.refusalCorrectness -
                reference.answerMetricTolerance
        ),
        hallucinationWithinBudget: atMost(
            answers.summary.hallucinationRate,
            reference.answers.hallucinationRate +
                reference.answerMetricTolerance
        ),
    };

    for (const expected of reference.cases) {
        const actual = retrieval.cases.find(
            (testCase) => testCase.id === expected.id
        );
        const prefix = `case.${expected.id}`;
        checks[`${prefix}.present`] = Boolean(actual);
        if (!actual) continue;
        checks[`${prefix}.vectorIdsAligned`] = actual.vectorIdsAligned;
        if (expected.passed) {
            checks[`${prefix}.previousPassPreserved`] = actual.passed;
        }
        if (expected.noAnswerExpected) {
            checks[`${prefix}.sourceCountNonIncrease`] =
                actual.results.length <= expected.sourceCount;
        } else {
            checks[`${prefix}.recallNonRegression`] = atLeast(
                actual.recallAtK,
                expected.recallAtK
            );
            checks[`${prefix}.coverageNonRegression`] = atLeast(
                actual.evidenceCoverage,
                expected.evidenceCoverage
            );
            checks[`${prefix}.rankNonRegression`] = atLeast(
                actual.reciprocalRank,
                expected.reciprocalRank
            );
            checks[`${prefix}.vectorRankNonRegression`] = atLeast(
                actual.vectorReciprocalRank,
                expected.vectorReciprocalRank
            );
            checks[`${prefix}.chunkWindowNonRegression`] =
                !expected.chunkWindowHit || actual.chunkWindowHit;
            checks[`${prefix}.chapterNonRegression`] =
                expected.chapterCorrect !== true ||
                actual.chapterCorrect === true;
        }
    }

    const observedKnownGaps = reference.knownGaps
        .filter((gap) => {
            const retrievalCase = retrieval.cases.find(
                (testCase) => testCase.id === gap.caseId
            );
            const answerCases = answers.cases as Array<{
                id?: string;
                passed?: boolean;
            }>;
            return (
                (gap.stages.includes("retrieval") &&
                    retrievalCase?.passed === false) ||
                (gap.stages.includes("answer") &&
                    answerCases.some(
                        (testCase) =>
                            testCase.id === gap.caseId && !testCase.passed
                    ))
            );
        })
        .map((gap) => gap.caseId);
    const improvements = reference.knownGaps
        .filter((gap) => !observedKnownGaps.includes(gap.caseId))
        .map((gap) => gap.caseId);
    const failedChecks = Object.entries(checks)
        .filter(([, passed]) => !passed)
        .map(([name]) => name);

    return {
        referenceVersion: reference.referenceVersion,
        pipelineVersion: reference.pipelineVersion,
        datasetSha256,
        fixtureManifestSha256,
        passed: failedChecks.length === 0,
        checks,
        failedChecks,
        improvements,
        observedKnownGaps,
    };
};

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import type { RagEvalFixture } from "./types";

const FIXTURE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, "../fixtures");
const MANIFEST_PATH = path.join(FIXTURE_DIR, "manifest.json");

const requiredString = (
    value: unknown,
    field: keyof RagEvalFixture,
    index: number
) => {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
        throw new Error(`Fixture manifest entry ${index + 1} requires ${field}`);
    }
    return value;
};

export const loadFixtureManifest = async (
    manifestPath = MANIFEST_PATH
): Promise<RagEvalFixture[]> => {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(manifestPath, "utf8")) as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || !parsed.length) {
        throw new Error("Fixture manifest must be a non-empty array");
    }

    const ids = new Set<string>();
    return parsed.map((value, index) => {
        if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
            throw new Error(
                `Fixture manifest entry ${index + 1} must be an object`
            );
        }
        const entry = value as Record<string, unknown>;
        const fixture: RagEvalFixture = {
            id: requiredString(entry.id, "id", index),
            fileName: requiredString(entry.fileName, "fileName", index),
            title: requiredString(entry.title, "title", index),
            author: requiredString(entry.author, "author", index),
            downloadUrl: requiredString(
                entry.downloadUrl,
                "downloadUrl",
                index
            ),
            sourceRepository: requiredString(
                entry.sourceRepository,
                "sourceRepository",
                index
            ),
            sourceRevision: requiredString(
                entry.sourceRevision,
                "sourceRevision",
                index
            ),
            sha256: requiredString(entry.sha256, "sha256", index),
            sizeBytes: Number(entry.sizeBytes),
        };
        if (
            !Number.isSafeInteger(fixture.sizeBytes) ||
            fixture.sizeBytes <= 0
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                `Fixture manifest entry ${index + 1} requires sizeBytes`
            );
        }
        if (ids.has(fixture.id)) {
            throw new Error(`Duplicate fixture id: ${fixture.id}`);
        }
        ids.add(fixture.id);
        return fixture;
    });
};

export const getFixture = (
    fixtures: RagEvalFixture[],
    fixtureId: string
) => {
    const fixture = fixtures.find((candidate) => candidate.id === fixtureId);
    if (!fixture) throw new Error(`Unknown fixture: ${fixtureId}`);
    return fixture;
};

export const verifyFixture = async (
    fixture: RagEvalFixture,
    fixtureDir = FIXTURE_DIR
) => {
    const filePath = path.join(fixtureDir, fixture.fileName);
    const buffer = await fs.readFile(filePath);
    const sha256 = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex");
    if (sha256 !== fixture.sha256) {
        throw new Error(
            `${fixture.id} checksum mismatch: expected ${fixture.sha256}, received ${sha256}`
        );
    }
    if (buffer.length !== fixture.sizeBytes) {
        throw new Error(
            `${fixture.id} size mismatch: expected ${fixture.sizeBytes}, received ${buffer.length}`
        );
    }
    return { buffer, filePath };
};

export interface TextChunkerOptions {
    minChunkSize?: number;
    targetChunkSize?: number;
    maxChunkSize?: number;
}

export class TextChunker {
    private readonly minChunkSize: number;
    private readonly targetChunkSize: number;
    private readonly maxChunkSize: number;

    constructor(options: TextChunkerOptions = {}) {
        this.minChunkSize = options.minChunkSize ?? 100;
        this.targetChunkSize = options.targetChunkSize ?? 1000;
        this.maxChunkSize = options.maxChunkSize ?? 3800;
    }

    chunkText(text: string): string[] {
        const normalized = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (!normalized) return [];
        if (normalized.length <= this.maxChunkSize) return [normalized];

        const sentences = normalized.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+(?:\s+|$)/g) || [
            normalized,
        ];
        const chunks: string[] = [];
        let current = "";

        for (const sentence of sentences) {
            const candidate = `${current} ${sentence}`.trim();
            if (candidate.length <= this.targetChunkSize || !current) {
                current = candidate;
                continue;
            }

            chunks.push(...this.splitOversized(current));
            current = sentence.trim();
        }

        if (current) {
            chunks.push(...this.splitOversized(current));
        }

        const nonEmpty = chunks.filter(Boolean);
        if (
            nonEmpty.length > 1 &&
            nonEmpty[nonEmpty.length - 1].length < this.minChunkSize
        ) {
            const tail = nonEmpty.pop()!;
            nonEmpty[nonEmpty.length - 1] =
                `${nonEmpty[nonEmpty.length - 1]} ${tail}`.trim();
        }
        return nonEmpty;
    }

    private splitOversized(text: string): string[] {
        if (text.length <= this.maxChunkSize) return [text];

        const chunks = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += this.maxChunkSize) {
            chunks.push(text.slice(i, i + this.maxChunkSize).trim());
        }
        return chunks.filter(Boolean);
    }
}

import crypto from "crypto";
import PDFParser from "pdf2json";
import { TextChunker } from "./chunkText";
import type { ProcessedTextChunk } from "./bookProcessing";

export const extractPdfChunks = async (
    fileBuffer: Buffer,
    chunker = new TextChunker()
): Promise<ProcessedTextChunk[]> =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const parser = new PDFParser();
        const allChunks: ProcessedTextChunk[] = [];
        const cleanup = () => parser.removeAllListeners();

        parser.on("pdfParser_dataReady", (pdfData) => {
            try {
                for (const [pageIndex, page] of pdfData.Pages.entries()) {
                    const textPage = page.Texts.map((text) =>
                        text.R.map((run) => decodeURIComponent(run.T)).join("")
                    ).join(" ");
                    allChunks.push(
                        ...chunker.chunkText(textPage).map((content) => ({
                            content,
                            metadata: {
                                pageNumber: pageIndex + 1,
                            },
                        }))
                    );
                }
                cleanup();
                resolve(allChunks);
            } catch (error) {
                cleanup();
                reject(error);
            }
        });

        parser.on("pdfParser_dataError", (error) => {
            cleanup();
            reject(error);
        });

        parser.parseBuffer(fileBuffer);
    });

export const createPdfCollectionName = async (
    fileBuffer: Buffer
): Promise<string> =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const parser = new PDFParser();
        const cleanup = () => parser.removeAllListeners();

        parser.on("pdfParser_dataReady", (pdfData) => {
            try {
                const hash = crypto.createHash("sha256");
                hash.update(
                    JSON.stringify({
                        pages: pdfData.Pages.length,
                        info: pdfData.Meta,
                    })
                );
                cleanup();
                resolve(`pdf_${hash.digest("hex").slice(0, 12)}`);
            } catch (error) {
                cleanup();
                reject(error);
            }
        });

        parser.on("pdfParser_dataError", (error) => {
            cleanup();
            reject(error);
        });

        parser.parseBuffer(fileBuffer);
    });

<file path="packages/providers/src/logger.ts">
export type LogLevel = "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error";

const LEVELS: Record<LogLevel, number> = {
    debug: 0,
    info: 1,
    warn: 2,
    error: 3,
};

const getLevel = (): LogLevel => {
    const env = process.env.LOG_LEVEL?.toLowerCase();
    if (env && env in LEVELS) return env as LogLevel;
    return process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "info" : "debug";
};

const currentLevel = getLevel();
const shouldLog = (level: LogLevel) => LEVELS[level] >= LEVELS[currentLevel];

const formatMessage = (
    level: LogLevel,
    component: string,
    message: string,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
    const entry = {
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        level,
        component,
        message,
        ...(meta ? { meta } : {}),
    };
    return JSON.stringify(entry);
};

const log = (
    level: LogLevel,
    component: string,
    message: string,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
    if (!shouldLog(level)) return;

    const output = formatMessage(level, component, message, meta);

    switch (level) {
        case "error":
            console.error(output);
            return;
        case "warn":
            console.warn(output);
            return;
        case "debug":
            console.debug(output);
            return;
        default:
            console.log(output);
    }
};

export interface Logger {
    debug: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    info: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    warn: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    error: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
}

export const contentFreeQueryLogMetadata = (
    query: string,
    metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {}
) => ({
    ...metadata,
    queryLength: query.length,
});

export const createLogger = (component: string): Logger => ({
    debug: (message, meta) => log("debug", component, message, meta),
    info: (message, meta) => log("info", component, message, meta),
    warn: (message, meta) => log("warn", component, message, meta),
    error: (message, meta) => log("error", component, message, meta),
});

export const logger = createLogger("reader");
</file>

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
AWS_ACCOUNT_ID="${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID:?Set AWS_ACCOUNT_ID to your AWS account ID}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)}"
PROJECT_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME:-reader}"

REGISTRY="${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com"

aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_REGION" \
    | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$REGISTRY"

for service in api worker web; do
    repository="${PROJECT_NAME}-${service}"
    image_uri="${REGISTRY}/${repository}:${IMAGE_TAG}"

    aws ecr describe-repositories \
        --region "$AWS_REGION" \
        --repository-names "$repository" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
        || aws ecr create-repository \
            --region "$AWS_REGION" \
            --repository-name "$repository" \
            --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true >/dev/null

    if [[ "$service" == "web" ]]; then
        : "${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:?Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL for the web image build}"
        : "${NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:?Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID for the web image build}"

        docker build \
            -f Dockerfile.web \
            --build-arg "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}" \
            --build-arg "NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=${NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}" \
            -t "${repository}:${IMAGE_TAG}" .
    else
        docker build -f "Dockerfile.${service}" -t "${repository}:${IMAGE_TAG}" .
    fi

    docker tag "${repository}:${IMAGE_TAG}" "$image_uri"
    docker push "$image_uri"
    printf '%s\n' "$image_uri"
done

<file path="scripts/force-deploy-ecs-services.sh">
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
ECS_CLUSTER="${ECS_CLUSTER:?Set ECS_CLUSTER to your ECS cluster name}"

deploy() {
    local service="$1" task_definition="$2" previous
    previous=$(aws ecs describe-services --region "$AWS_REGION" --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
        --services "$service" --query 'services[0].taskDefinition' --output text)
    aws ecs update-service \
        --region "$AWS_REGION" \
        --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
        --service "$service" \
        --task-definition "$task_definition" >/dev/null

    if ! aws ecs wait services-stable \
        --region "$AWS_REGION" \
        --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
        --services "$service"; then
        aws ecs update-service --region "$AWS_REGION" --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
            --service "$service" --task-definition "$previous" >/dev/null
        aws ecs wait services-stable --region "$AWS_REGION" --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
            --services "$service"
        return 1
    fi
}

deploy "${ECS_API_SERVICE:?Set ECS_API_SERVICE}" "${ECS_API_TASK_DEFINITION:?Set ECS_API_TASK_DEFINITION}"
deploy "${ECS_WORKER_SERVICE:?Set ECS_WORKER_SERVICE}" "${ECS_WORKER_TASK_DEFINITION:?Set ECS_WORKER_TASK_DEFINITION}"
deploy "${ECS_WEB_SERVICE:?Set ECS_WEB_SERVICE}" "${ECS_WEB_TASK_DEFINITION:?Set ECS_WEB_TASK_DEFINITION}"

<file path="scripts/register-ecs-task-definitions.sh">
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
AWS_ACCOUNT_ID="${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID:?Set AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:?Set IMAGE_TAG to the commit SHA}"
ECS_CLUSTER="${ECS_CLUSTER:?Set ECS_CLUSTER}"
REGISTRY="${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com"

register_revision() {
    local current_arn="$1" container="$2" image_service="$3"
    local definition image_uri new_arn
    definition=$(aws ecs describe-task-definition --region "$AWS_REGION" \
        --task-definition "$current_arn" --query taskDefinition --output json)
    image_uri="${REGISTRY}/reader-${image_service}:${IMAGE_TAG}"
    new_arn=$(jq --arg container "$container" --arg image "$image_uri" '
        del(.taskDefinitionArn,.revision,.status,.requiresAttributes,.compatibilities,.registeredAt,.registeredBy)
        | (.containerDefinitions[] | select(.name == $container).image) = $image
    ' <<<"$definition" | aws ecs register-task-definition --region "$AWS_REGION" \
        --cli-input-json file:///dev/stdin --query taskDefinition.taskDefinitionArn --output text)
    printf '%s' "$new_arn"
}

service_task() {
    aws ecs describe-services --region "$AWS_REGION" --cluster "$ECS_CLUSTER" \
        --services "$1" --query 'services[0].taskDefinition' --output text
}

api_arn=$(register_revision "$(service_task "${ECS_API_SERVICE:?Set ECS_API_SERVICE}")" api api)
worker_arn=$(register_revision "$(service_task "${ECS_WORKER_SERVICE:?Set ECS_WORKER_SERVICE}")" worker worker)
web_arn=$(register_revision "$(service_task "${ECS_WEB_SERVICE:?Set ECS_WEB_SERVICE}")" web web)
migration_arn=$(register_revision "${ECS_MIGRATION_TASK_DEFINITION:?Set ECS_MIGRATION_TASK_DEFINITION}" migration api)

cat <<EOF
ECS_API_TASK_DEFINITION=$api_arn
ECS_WORKER_TASK_DEFINITION=$worker_arn
ECS_WEB_TASK_DEFINITION=$web_arn
ECS_MIGRATION_TASK_DEFINITION=$migration_arn
EOF
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/observability/langfuse.ts">
import { LangfuseSpanProcessor } from "@langfuse/otel";
import {
    propagateAttributes,
    startActiveObservation,
    type LangfuseObservation,
    type LangfuseObservationAttributes,
    type LangfuseObservationType,
    type LangfuseTraceAttributes,
    type PropagateAttributesParams,
} from "@langfuse/tracing";
import type { LangfuseConfig } from "@langfuse/openai";
import { NodeSDK } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-node";
import { TraceIdRatioBasedSampler } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base";
import { createLogger } from "@reader/providers";

const log = createLogger("langfuse");
const DEFAULT_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS = 500;
const MIN_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS = 20;
const SENSITIVE_TEXT_KEYS = new Set([
    "content",
    "prompt",
    "query",
    "context",
    "completion",
    "response",
    "assistantResponse",
    "documents",
    "document",
    "text",
    "error",
]);

let sdk: NodeSDK | null = null;

export type LangfuseCaptureMode = "metadata" | "snippets";

export interface LangfuseCaptureConfig {
    mode: LangfuseCaptureMode;
    maxChars: number;
}

export interface TraceObservation {
    readonly id?: string;
    readonly traceId?: string;
    update(attributes: LangfuseObservationAttributes): TraceObservation;
    setTraceIO(attributes: LangfuseTraceAttributes): TraceObservation;
    startObservation(
        name: string,
        attributes?: LangfuseObservationAttributes,
        options?: { asType?: LangfuseObservationType }
    ): TraceObservation;
    end(): void;
    getSpanContext(): LangfuseConfig["parentSpanContext"] | undefined;
}

const noopObservation: TraceObservation = (() => {
    let noop: TraceObservation;
    noop = {
        update: () => noop,
        setTraceIO: () => noop,
        startObservation: () => noop,
        end: () => undefined,
        getSpanContext: () => undefined,
    };
    return noop;
})();

const parsePositiveInteger = (value: string | undefined, fallback: number) => {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < MIN_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS) {
        return fallback;
    }
    return parsed;
};

const parseSampleRate = () => {
    const raw = process.env.LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE;
    if (!raw) return 1;

    const parsed = Number(raw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 1;
    if (parsed <= 0) return 0;
    if (parsed >= 1) return 1;
    return parsed;
};

export const isLangfuseTracingConfigured = () =>
    Boolean(process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY && process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY);

export const isLangfuseTracingEnabled = () =>
    isLangfuseTracingConfigured() && parseSampleRate() > 0;

export const getLangfuseCaptureConfig = (): LangfuseCaptureConfig => ({
    mode:
        process.env.LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_CONTENT === "snippets"
            ? "snippets"
            : "metadata",
    maxChars: parsePositiveInteger(
        process.env.LANGFUSE_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS,
        DEFAULT_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS
    ),
});

export const snippetForLangfuse = (
    text: string,
    capture = getLangfuseCaptureConfig()
) => {
    if (capture.mode !== "snippets") return undefined;
    return text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, capture.maxChars);
};

const shouldMaskString = (key: string | undefined) =>
    key ? SENSITIVE_TEXT_KEYS.has(key) : false;

const maskValue = (
    value: unknown,
    key: string | undefined,
    capture: LangfuseCaptureConfig
): unknown => {
    if (typeof value === "string") {
        if (capture.mode === "snippets") {
            return value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, capture.maxChars);
        }

        return shouldMaskString(key) ? "[redacted]" : value;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return value.map((item) => maskValue(item, key, capture));
    }

    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const masked: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const [childKey, childValue] of Object.entries(
            value as Record<string, unknown>
        )) {
            masked[childKey] = maskValue(childValue, childKey, capture);
        }
        return masked;
    }

    return value;
};

const stringifyLangfuseAttribute = (value: unknown) => {
    try {
        return typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
        return "<failed to serialize>";
    }
};

export const maskLangfuseAttribute = (
    data: unknown,
    capture = getLangfuseCaptureConfig()
) => {
    if (typeof data !== "string") {
        return maskValue(data, undefined, capture);
    }

    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
        return stringifyLangfuseAttribute(
            maskValue(parsed, undefined, capture)
        );
    } catch {
        return maskValue(data, undefined, capture);
    }
};

const wrapObservation = (
    observation: LangfuseObservation
): TraceObservation => {
    const wrapped: TraceObservation = {
        id: observation.id,
        traceId: observation.traceId,
        update(attributes) {
            (observation as any).update(attributes);
            return wrapped;
        },
        setTraceIO(attributes) {
            observation.setTraceIO(attributes);
            return wrapped;
        },
        startObservation(name, attributes, options) {
            return wrapObservation(
                (observation as any).startObservation(name, attributes, options)
            );
        },
        end() {
            observation.end();
        },
        getSpanContext() {
            return observation.otelSpan.spanContext();
        },
    };

    return wrapped;
};

export const getNoopTraceObservation = () => noopObservation;

const CONTENT_FREE_CAPTURE: LangfuseCaptureConfig = {
    mode: "metadata",
    maxChars: DEFAULT_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS,
};

export const getContentFreeTraceObservation = (
    observation: TraceObservation
): TraceObservation => {
    let wrapped: TraceObservation;
    wrapped = {
        id: observation.id,
        traceId: observation.traceId,
        update(attributes) {
            observation.update(
                maskLangfuseAttribute(
                    attributes,
                    CONTENT_FREE_CAPTURE
                ) as LangfuseObservationAttributes
            );
            return wrapped;
        },
        setTraceIO(attributes) {
            observation.setTraceIO(
                maskLangfuseAttribute(
                    attributes,
                    CONTENT_FREE_CAPTURE
                ) as LangfuseTraceAttributes
            );
            return wrapped;
        },
        startObservation(name, attributes, options) {
            const sanitized = attributes
                ? (maskLangfuseAttribute(
                      attributes,
                      CONTENT_FREE_CAPTURE
                  ) as LangfuseObservationAttributes)
                : undefined;
            return getContentFreeTraceObservation(
                observation.startObservation(name, sanitized, options)
            );
        },
        end: () => observation.end(),
        getSpanContext: () => observation.getSpanContext(),
    };
    return wrapped;
};

export const getErrorMessage = (error: unknown) =>
    error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

export const recordObservationError = (
    observation: TraceObservation | undefined,
    error: unknown,
    statusMessage = "Observation failed"
) => {
    if (!observation) return;
    observation.update({
        level: "ERROR",
        statusMessage,
        output: { error: getErrorMessage(error) },
    });
};

export const shutdownLangfuseTracing = async () => {
    if (!sdk) return;

    const activeSdk = sdk;
    sdk = null;

    try {
        await activeSdk.shutdown();
    } catch (error) {
        log.warn("Error shutting down Langfuse tracing", {
            error: getErrorMessage(error),
        });
    }
};

export const startLangfuseTracing = (serviceName = "reader-api") => {
    if (!isLangfuseTracingConfigured()) {
        log.info("Langfuse tracing disabled; missing credentials");
        return;
    }

    if (sdk) return;

    const sampleRate = parseSampleRate();
    if (sampleRate <= 0) {
        log.info("Langfuse tracing disabled by sample rate");
        return;
    }

    const capture = getLangfuseCaptureConfig();
    sdk = new NodeSDK({
        serviceName,
        sampler: new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(sampleRate),
        spanProcessors: [
            new LangfuseSpanProcessor({
                publicKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY,
                secretKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY,
                baseUrl: process.env.LANGFUSE_BASE_URL || undefined,
                environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
                mask: ({ data }) => {
                    return maskLangfuseAttribute(data, capture);
                },
            }),
        ],
    });

    sdk.start();
    log.info("Langfuse tracing enabled", {
        sampleRate,
        captureMode: capture.mode,
        maxCaptureChars: capture.maxChars,
        hasBaseUrl: Boolean(process.env.LANGFUSE_BASE_URL),
    });
};

export interface BookChatTraceContext {
    userId: string;
    conversationId: string;
    resourceType: string;
    resourceId: string;
    routeName: string;
    messageCount: number;
    queryLength: number;
    hasHighlightContext?: boolean;
}

export interface RagShadowTraceContext {
    userId: string;
    conversationId: string;
    bookId: string;
    assistantMessageId: string;
    baselineTraceId: string | null;
}

export const withRagShadowTrace = <T>(
    context: RagShadowTraceContext,
    fn: (trace: TraceObservation) => T
): T => {
    if (!isLangfuseTracingEnabled()) return fn(noopObservation);

    return startActiveObservation(
        "rag_rerank_shadow",
        (observation) => {
            const trace = wrapObservation(observation);
            return propagateAttributes(
                {
                    traceName: "rag_rerank_shadow",
                    userId: context.userId,
                    sessionId: context.conversationId,
                    tags: ["reader-worker", "rag-shadow", "rerank-rag-v1"],
                    metadata: {
                        bookId: context.bookId,
                        assistantMessageId: context.assistantMessageId,
                        ...(context.baselineTraceId
                            ? { baselineTraceId: context.baselineTraceId }
                            : {}),
                        environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
                    },
                },
                () => fn(trace)
            );
        },
        { endOnExit: true }
    );
};

export const withBookChatTrace = <T>(
    context: BookChatTraceContext,
    fn: (trace: TraceObservation) => T
): T => {
    if (!isLangfuseTracingEnabled()) {
        return fn(noopObservation);
    }

    return startActiveObservation(
        "chat_with_book",
        (observation) => {
            const trace = wrapObservation(observation);
            const propagated: PropagateAttributesParams = {
                traceName: "chat_with_book",
                userId: context.userId,
                sessionId: context.conversationId,
                tags: ["reader-api", "book-chat", context.routeName],
                metadata: {
                    routeName: context.routeName,
                    resourceType: context.resourceType,
                    resourceId: context.resourceId,
                    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
                },
            };

            return propagateAttributes(propagated, () => {
                trace.setTraceIO({
                    input: {
                        resourceType: context.resourceType,
                        resourceId: context.resourceId,
                        messageCount: context.messageCount,
                        queryLength: context.queryLength,
                        hasHighlightContext: Boolean(
                            context.hasHighlightContext
                        ),
                    },
                });

                try {
                    const result = fn(trace);
                    if (result instanceof Promise) {
                        return result.catch((error) => {
                            recordObservationError(
                                trace,
                                error,
                                "Book chat failed"
                            );
                            throw error;
                        }) as T;
                    }

                    return result;
                } catch (error) {
                    recordObservationError(trace, error, "Book chat failed");
                    throw error;
                }
            });
        },
        { endOnExit: true }
    );
};

import { Messages } from "../db/schema";
import type { MessageExecutionMetadata } from "../types/ragTelemetry";
import type { BookContextResult } from "./BookRagService";
import {
    AI_PRICING_VERSION,
    estimateModelCost,
    normalizeModelUsage,
} from "./AiUsage";

export const PUBLIC_MESSAGE_SELECTION = {
    id: Messages.id,
    conversationId: Messages.conversationId,
    role: Messages.role,
    content: Messages.content,
    contextSources: Messages.contextSources,
    completionStatus: Messages.completionStatus,
    finishReason: Messages.finishReason,
    createdAt: Messages.createdAt,
};

export const buildMessageExecutionMetadata = ({
    telemetry,
    model,
    usage,
    generationDurationMs,
    totalLatencyMs,
    langfuseTraceId,
}: {
    telemetry: BookContextResult["telemetry"];
    model: string;
    usage: unknown;
    generationDurationMs: number;
    totalLatencyMs: number;
    langfuseTraceId?: string;
}): MessageExecutionMetadata => {
    const normalizedUsage = normalizeModelUsage(usage);
    const generationCost = estimateModelCost(model, normalizedUsage);
    const retrievalCost =
        telemetry.retrieval?.mode === "reranked"
            ? telemetry.retrieval.reranker.estimatedCost
            : null;
    const retrievalCostKnownZero =
        telemetry.retrieval?.mode === "reranked" &&
        telemetry.retrieval.reranker.status === "skipped";
    const combinedCost =
        generationCost &&
        (telemetry.retrieval?.mode !== "reranked" ||
            retrievalCost ||
            retrievalCostKnownZero)
            ? {
                  currency: "USD" as const,
                  amount: generationCost.amount + (retrievalCost?.amount ?? 0),
                  pricingVersion: AI_PRICING_VERSION,
              }
            : null;
    return {
        pipelineVersion: telemetry.pipelineVersion,
        promptVersion: telemetry.promptVersion,
        pricingVersion: AI_PRICING_VERSION,
        modelVersion: model,
        queryPlan: telemetry.queryPlan,
        retrieval: telemetry.retrieval,
        generation: {
            durationMs: generationDurationMs,
            usage: normalizedUsage,
            estimatedCost: generationCost,
        },
        retrievalCost,
        combinedCost,
        totalLatencyMs,
        langfuseTraceId: langfuseTraceId ?? null,
    };
};

import express from "express";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import authRoutes from "./routes/Auth.routes";

import bookRoutes from "./routes/Book.routes";
import chatRoutes from "./routes/Chat.routes";
import healthRoutes from "./routes/Health.routes";
import tracker from "./routes/Tracker.routes";
import cors from "cors";
import { logger } from "./middleware/logger";
import { enforceTrustedOrigin } from "./middleware/csrf";
import { authRateLimit } from "./middleware/rateLimit";
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const allowedOrigins = [
    process.env.FRONTEND_URL,
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
        ? []
        : [
              "http://localhost:5173",
              "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
              "http://localhost:3001",
              "http://127.0.0.1:3001",
          ]),
].filter(Boolean);

if (allowedOrigins.length === 0) {
    console.warn("No CORS origins configured");
}

app.use(
    cors({
        origin: (origin, callback) => {
            if (!origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) {
                callback(null, true);
                return;
            }

            callback(new Error(`CORS origin not allowed: ${origin}`));
        },
        methods: ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH", "OPTIONS"],
        allowedHeaders: ["Content-Type", "Authorization"],
        credentials: true,
    })
);

app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: false }));
app.use(logger);
app.use(enforceTrustedOrigin);

app.get("/", (req, res) => {
    res.send("Hello World");
});

app.use("/health", healthRoutes);

// auth routes
app.use("/api/auth", authRateLimit, authRoutes);
app.use("/api/user", userRoutes);
app.use("/api/books", bookRoutes);
app.use("/api", chatRoutes);
app.use("/api", tracker);

app.use(
    (
        error: unknown,
        _req: express.Request,
        res: express.Response,
        _next: express.NextFunction
    ) => {
        console.error("Unhandled request error", error);
        if (!res.headersSent)
            res.status(500).json({ error: "Internal server error" });
    }
);
export default app;

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";
import { maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow } from "../src/services/RagShadowEnqueueService";

const input = {
    assistantMessageId: "assistant-1",
    userMessageId: "user-message-1",
    conversationId: "conversation-1",
    bookId: "book-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    hasHighlightContext: false,
};

test("shadow enqueue sends only durable identifiers", async () => {
    const enqueued: unknown[] = [];
    const status = await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow(input, {
        sampleRate: 1,
        enqueue: async (payload) => {
            enqueued.push(payload);
        },
    });

    assert.equal(status, "enqueued");
    assert.deepEqual(enqueued, [
        {
            assistantMessageId: "assistant-1",
            userMessageId: "user-message-1",
            conversationId: "conversation-1",
            bookId: "book-1",
            userId: "user-1",
        },
    ]);
});

test("shadow enqueue excludes highlighted requests", async () => {
    let called = false;
    const status = await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow(
        { ...input, hasHighlightContext: true },
        {
            sampleRate: 1,
            enqueue: async () => {
                called = true;
            },
        }
    );
    assert.equal(status, "excluded_highlight");
    assert.equal(called, false);
});

test("shadow enqueue is disabled at zero sample rate", async () => {
    let called = false;
    const status = await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow(input, {
        sampleRate: 0,
        enqueue: async () => {
            called = true;
        },
    });
    assert.equal(status, "not_sampled");
    assert.equal(called, false);
});

test("shadow queue failures never reject chat completion", async () => {
    const status = await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow(input, {
        sampleRate: 1,
        enqueue: async () => {
            throw new Error("redis unavailable");
        },
    });
    assert.equal(status, "enqueue_failed");
});

test("invalid shadow configuration never rejects chat completion", async () => {
    const previous = process.env.RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE;
    process.env.RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE = "invalid";
    try {
        const status = await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow(input, {
            enqueue: async () => {
                throw new Error("must not enqueue");
            },
        });
        assert.equal(status, "invalid_configuration");
    } finally {
        if (previous === undefined) {
            delete process.env.RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE;
        } else {
            process.env.RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE = previous;
        }
    }
});

test("chat ends the SSE response before awaiting shadow queue I/O", () => {
    const route = readFileSync(
        join(
            resolve(__dirname, "../../.."),
            "apps/api/src/routes/Chat.routes.ts"
        ),
        "utf8"
    );
    const completionStart = route.indexOf(
        "const assistantMessage = await saveAssistantMessage"
    );
    const completionEnd = route.indexOf(
        "const runBookChatTraceIfNeeded",
        completionStart
    );
    const completion = route.slice(completionStart, completionEnd);

    assert.ok(completionStart >= 0);
    assert.ok(completionEnd > completionStart);
    assert.ok(completion.indexOf("res.end();") >= 0);

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import type { Book } from "@/types/bookTypes";
import { resolveRelativePath } from "@/lib/utils";

interface BookCoverProps {
    book: Book;
    className?: string;
    iconClassName?: string;
}

const imageMimeTypes: Record<string, string> = {
    avif: "image/avif",
    gif: "image/gif",
    jpeg: "image/jpeg",
    jpg: "image/jpeg",
    png: "image/png",
    svg: "image/svg+xml",
    webp: "image/webp",
};

const getMimeType = (path: string) => {
    const extension = path.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();
    return extension
        ? (imageMimeTypes[extension] ?? "image/jpeg")
        : "image/jpeg";
};

const getOpfPath = async (zip: JSZip) => {
    const containerXml = await zip
        .file("META-INF/container.xml")
        ?.async("text");
    if (!containerXml) return null;

    const container = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
        containerXml,
        "application/xml"
    );
    return (
        container
            .querySelector("rootfile")
            ?.getAttribute("full-path")
            ?.trim() || null
    );
};

const getCoverPathFromOpf = (opfContent: string) => {
    const opf = new DOMParser().parseFromString(opfContent, "application/xml");
    const coverImageItem = opf.querySelector(
        "manifest > item[properties~='cover-image']"
    );
    if (coverImageItem?.getAttribute("href")) {
        return coverImageItem.getAttribute("href");
    }

    const coverId = opf
        .querySelector("metadata > meta[name='cover']")
        ?.getAttribute("content");
    if (coverId) {
        const coverItem = opf.querySelector(
            `manifest > item[id="${CSS.escape(coverId)}"]`
        );
        if (coverItem?.getAttribute("href")) {
            return coverItem.getAttribute("href");
        }
    }

    return opf
        .querySelector("manifest > item[media-type^='image/']")
        ?.getAttribute("href");
};

const extractEpubCoverUrl = async (file: Blob) => {
    const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const opfPath = await getOpfPath(zip);
    if (!opfPath) return null;

    const opfContent = await zip.file(opfPath)?.async("text");
    if (!opfContent) return null;

    const coverPath = getCoverPathFromOpf(opfContent);
    if (!coverPath) return null;

    const opfBasePath = opfPath.includes("/")
        ? opfPath.slice(0, opfPath.lastIndexOf("/") + 1)
        : "";
    const resolvedCoverPath = resolveRelativePath(coverPath, opfBasePath);
    const coverFile = zip.file(resolvedCoverPath) ?? zip.file(coverPath);
    if (!coverFile) return null;

    const coverBlob = new Blob([await coverFile.async("arraybuffer")], {
        type: getMimeType(resolvedCoverPath),
    });
    return URL.createObjectURL(coverBlob);
};

export default function BookCover({
    book,
    className = "",
    iconClassName = "text-4xl",
}: BookCoverProps) {
    const [coverUrl, setCoverUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const element = containerRef.current;
        if (!element) return;
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            ([entry]) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setIsVisible(true);
                    observer.disconnect();
                }
            },
            { rootMargin: "200px" }
        );
        observer.observe(element);
        return () => observer.disconnect();
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (book.fileType !== "epub" || !isVisible) {
            setCoverUrl(null);
            return;
        }

        let isCancelled = false;
        let objectUrl: string | null = null;

        const loadCover = async () => {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/books/${book.id}`,
                    {
                        credentials: "include",
                    }
                );
                if (!response.ok) return;

                objectUrl = await extractEpubCoverUrl(await response.blob());
                if (!isCancelled) {
                    setCoverUrl(objectUrl);
                } else if (objectUrl) {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn("Failed to load EPUB cover", {
                    bookId: book.id,
                    error,
                });
            }
        };

        loadCover();

        return () => {
            isCancelled = true;
            if (objectUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
            }
        };
    }, [book.fileType, book.id, isVisible]);

    return (
        <div
            ref={containerRef}
            className={`relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-surface-container shadow-sm ${className}`}
        >
            {coverUrl ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img
                    src={coverUrl}
                    alt={`${book.title} cover`}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                />
            ) : (
                <>
                    <div
                        className={`absolute inset-0 ${
                            book.fileType === "pdf"
                                ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-secondary/20 via-surface-container to-error/10"
                                : "bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/15 via-surface-container to-tertiary/10"
                        }`}
                    />
                    <span
                        className={`material-symbols-outlined relative z-10 text-on-surface-variant ${iconClassName}`}
                    >
                        {book.fileType === "pdf"
                            ? "picture_as_pdf"
                            : "menu_book"}
                    </span>
                </>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { processEpubFile } from "@/lib/epubProcessing";
import { type EpubContent } from "@/types/EpubReader";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import ePub from "epubjs";
import Section from "epubjs/types/section";

export const useEpubProcessor = () => {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [epubContent, setEpubContent] = useState<EpubContent | null>(null);
    const [zipData, setZipData] = useState<JSZip | null>(null);

    const processEpub = useCallback(async (url: string) => {
        try {
            setIsLoading(true);
            setError(null);
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                credentials: "include",
            });
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to fetch EPUB: ${response.statusText}`);
            }

            const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
            const [content, zip] = await processEpubFile(arrayBuffer);

            setZipData(zip);
            setEpubContent(content);
        } catch (err) {
            const errorMessage =
                err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error occurred";
            setError("Failed to process EPUB file: " + errorMessage);
            console.error(err);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    return {
        processEpub,
        isLoading,
        error,
        epubContent,
        zipData,
    };
};

export const useEpubJsProcessor = (url: string) => {
    const [bookChapters, setBookChapters] = useState<
        { id: string; content: string }[]
    >([]);
    const [chaptersLoading, setChaptersLoading] = useState(false);
    const [status, setStatus] = useState<
        "loading" | "error" | "idle" | "success"
    >("idle");

    const processEpubJs = async (bookUrl: string) => {
        setStatus("loading");
        setChaptersLoading(true);
        let book = ePub(bookUrl, {
            requestCredentials: true as unknown as object,
        });

        await book.loaded.navigation;
        book = await book.opened;
        const spineItems: Section[] = [];
        book.spine.each((spineItem: Section) => spineItems.push(spineItem));
        const chapters = [];
        for (const item of spineItems) {
            const document = (await book.load(item.href)) as Document;
            const images = document.body.getElementsByTagName("img");
            const basePath = "";

            // Process all images in parallel
            await Promise.all(
                Array.from(images).map(async (img) => {
                    const src = img.getAttribute("src");
                    if (src) {
                        try {
                            const relativePath = src.startsWith("/")
                                ? src.slice(1)
                                : src;
                            const fullPath = basePath
                                ? `${basePath}/${relativePath}`
                                : relativePath;
                            const imageBlob =
                                await book.archive.getBlob(fullPath);

                            if (imageBlob) {
                                const arrayBuffer =
                                    await imageBlob.arrayBuffer();
                                const dataUrl =
                                    await createImageDataUrl(arrayBuffer);
                                img.src = dataUrl;
                            } else {
                                console.warn(
                                    `Image not found in epub: ${fullPath}`
                                );
                                img.src =
                                    'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"%3E%3Cpath fill="%23eee" d="M21 19V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2zM8.5 13.5l2.5 3.01L14.5 12l4.5 6H5l3.5-4.5z"/%3E%3C/svg%3E';
                            }
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.error(
                                `Failed to load image: ${src}`,
                                error
                            );
                            img.src =
                                'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"%3E%3Cpath fill="%23eee" d="M21 19V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2zM8.5 13.5l2.5 3.01L14.5 12l4.5 6H5l3.5-4.5z"/%3E%3C/svg%3E';
                        }
                    }
                })
            );

            chapters.push({
                id: item.href,
                content: document.body.innerHTML,
            });
        }
        setBookChapters(chapters);
        setStatus("success");
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!url) return;
        processEpubJs(url);
    }, [url]);

    return {
        epubJsContent: {},
        processEpubJs,
        bookChapters,
        chaptersLoading,
        status,
    };
};

async function createImageDataUrl(arrayBuffer: ArrayBuffer): Promise<string> {
    const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer)]);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
        reader.onerror = reject;
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
}

<file path="docs/rag-evaluation.md">
# RAG evaluation and metadata rollout

The required CI gate uses the checksum-pinned Alice EPUB fixture. It is a focused
regression gate for the current EPUB ingestion, retrieval, answer-generation,
and judging path. PDF and broader corpus coverage belong in separate changes so
this gate remains small and diagnosable.

The report's `Source revision` identifies the upstream Standard Ebooks fixture
revision. The fixture checksum identifies the exact bytes evaluated; it is not
the Reader repository commit SHA. GitHub Actions already records the tested
Reader merge SHA on the workflow run.

## Existing-book metadata policy

Migration `0013_stiff_jigsaw.sql` deliberately adds nullable chunk metadata
without rewriting existing indexes. Books processed after the migration receive
EPUB chapter metadata. Existing books continue to work with excerpt citations,
but chapter labels remain absent until those books are processed again.

There is no automatic bulk reindex during deployment. Reindexing can invoke
OpenAI embeddings, Chroma writes, object-storage reads, and database writes, so
it must be handled as a separately monitored operational migration. Until that
work exists, the supported rollout policy is:

- preserve existing chunks and their `null` metadata;
- tolerate missing chapter labels in API responses;
- populate metadata on every new or explicitly reprocessed book;
- do not claim historical books have chapter-level citation metadata.

## Gate behavior

- Standard tests and builds run before the paid live RAG gate.
- Answer generation runs the full dataset against every chat model exposed by
  Reader's UI, using temperature zero where the model supports it and bounded
  retries and timeouts.
- Every dataset case is judged; the command fails instead of silently applying
  a first-N truncation.
- Langfuse publication is best-effort observability and cannot change the local
  retrieval or answer-quality decision.

<file path="packages/evals/test/baselineRegression.test.js">
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");

const {
    computeBaselineInputHashes,
    evaluateBaselineRegression,
    loadBaselineReference,
    validateBaselineReference,
} = require("../dist/baselineRegression");
const { renderMarkdownReport } = require("../dist/report");

const clone = (value) => structuredClone(value);

const observationFrom = (reference) => ({
    reference,
    datasetSha256: reference.datasetSha256,
    fixtureManifestSha256: reference.fixtureManifestSha256,
    pipelineVersions: [reference.pipelineVersion],
    promptVersions: [reference.promptVersion],
    answerModels: [...reference.answerModels],
    judgeModel: reference.judgeModel,
    retrieval: {
        summary: {
            caseCount: reference.requiredCaseIds.length,
            ...clone(reference.retrieval),
            perCategory: {},
            passed: false,
        },
        cases: reference.cases.map((snapshot) => ({
            ...clone(snapshot),
            fixtureId: "alice",
            suite: "required",
            category: snapshot.noAnswerExpected ? "no_answer" : "factual",
            question: snapshot.id,
            results: Array.from({ length: snapshot.sourceCount }, (_, index) => ({
                id: `${snapshot.id}-${index}`,
            })),
            expectedChunkIds: [],
            sourceHit: snapshot.recallAtK === 1,
            vectorSourceHit: snapshot.vectorReciprocalRank > 0,
            pipelineVersion: reference.pipelineVersion,
            promptVersion: reference.promptVersion,
            retrievalDurationMs: 1,
        })),
    },
    answers: {
        summary: {
            caseCount: reference.judgedAnswerCount,
            ...clone(reference.answers),
            perCategory: {},
            passed: false,
        },
        cases: Array.from({ length: reference.judgedAnswerCount }, (_, index) => ({
            id:
                index < reference.answerModels.length
                    ? "rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase"
                    : reference.requiredCaseIds[
                          index % reference.requiredCaseIds.length
                      ],
            passed: index >= reference.answerModels.length,
        })),
    },
});

test("loads the pinned baseline reference and verifies input hashes", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const hashes = await computeBaselineInputHashes();

    assert.equal(reference.schemaVersion, 1);
    assert.equal(reference.requiredCaseIds.length, 7);
    assert.equal(hashes.datasetSha256, reference.datasetSha256);
    assert.equal(
        hashes.fixtureManifestSha256,
        reference.fixtureManifestSha256
    );
});

test("rejects invalid reference schemas, duplicate IDs, and unknown gaps", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    assert.throws(
        () => validateBaselineReference({ ...reference, schemaVersion: 2 }),
        /unsupported schema/
    );
    assert.throws(
        () =>
            validateBaselineReference({
                ...reference,
                requiredCaseIds: reference.requiredCaseIds.map((id, index) =>
                    index === 1 ? reference.requiredCaseIds[0] : id
                ),
            }),
        /seven unique/
    );
    assert.throws(
        () =>
            validateBaselineReference({
                ...reference,
                knownGaps: [
                    ...reference.knownGaps,
                    {
                        caseId: "unknown",
                        stages: ["retrieval"],
                        issue: 22,
                        description: "invalid",
                    },
                ],
            }),
        /known gaps/
    );
});

test("the exact baseline passes while preserving absolute quality misses", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const result = evaluateBaselineRegression(observationFrom(reference));

    assert.equal(result.passed, true);
    assert.deepEqual(result.failedChecks, []);
    assert.deepEqual(result.improvements, []);
    assert.deepEqual(result.observedKnownGaps.sort(), [
        "no-answer-railway",
        "rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase",
    ]);
});

test("accepts known-gap improvements without rewriting the reference", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const observation = observationFrom(reference);
    observation.retrieval.cases.find(
        (testCase) => testCase.id === "rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase"
    ).passed = true;
    for (const answer of observation.answers.cases) {
        if (answer.id === "rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase") answer.passed = true;
    }

    const result = evaluateBaselineRegression(observation);
    assert.equal(result.passed, true);
    assert.deepEqual(result.improvements, ["rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase"]);
});

test("fails aggregate, case-level, identity, and no-answer regressions", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const observation = observationFrom(reference);
    observation.datasetSha256 = "0".repeat(64);
    observation.retrieval.summary.mrr -= 0.01;
    observation.retrieval.cases.find(
        (testCase) => testCase.id === "rabbit-watch"
    ).passed = false;
    observation.retrieval.cases.find(
        (testCase) => testCase.id === "no-answer-railway"
    ).results.push({ id: "extra" });

    const result = evaluateBaselineRegression(observation);
    assert.equal(result.passed, false);
    assert.ok(result.failedChecks.includes("datasetSha256Matches"));
    assert.ok(result.failedChecks.includes("mrrNonRegression"));
    assert.ok(
        result.failedChecks.includes(
            "case.rabbit-watch.previousPassPreserved"
        )
    );
    assert.ok(
        result.failedChecks.includes(
            "case.no-answer-railway.sourceCountNonIncrease"
        )
    );
});

test("enforces the five-point answer-quality budget inclusively", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const boundary = observationFrom(reference);
    boundary.answers.summary.groundedness =
        reference.answers.groundedness - reference.answerMetricTolerance;
    boundary.answers.summary.hallucinationRate =
        reference.answers.hallucinationRate + reference.answerMetricTolerance;
    assert.equal(evaluateBaselineRegression(boundary).passed, true);

    const outside = observationFrom(reference);
    outside.answers.summary.groundedness =
        reference.answers.groundedness -
        reference.answerMetricTolerance -
        0.0001;
    outside.answers.summary.hallucinationRate =
        reference.answers.hallucinationRate +
        reference.answerMetricTolerance +
        0.0001;
    const result = evaluateBaselineRegression(outside);
    assert.equal(result.passed, false);
    assert.ok(result.failedChecks.includes("groundednessWithinBudget"));
    assert.ok(result.failedChecks.includes("hallucinationWithinBudget"));
});

test("renders absolute quality and baseline regression separately", async () => {
    const reference = await loadBaselineReference();
    const observation = observationFrom(reference);
    const regression = evaluateBaselineRegression(observation);
    const markdown = renderMarkdownReport({
        runId: "report",
        createdAt: "2026-07-17T00:00:00.000Z",
        suite: "required",
        qualityPassed: false,
        regression,
        answerModels: reference.answerModels,
        resolvedAnswerModels: reference.answerModels,
        judgeModel: reference.judgeModel,
        resolvedJudgeModels: [reference.judgeModel],
        execution: {
            pipelineVersions: [reference.pipelineVersion],
            promptVersions: [reference.promptVersion],
            pricingVersion: "test",
            latencyMs: { retrieval: 1, generation: 1, judge: 1, total: 3 },
            usage: { answers: null, judge: null },
            estimatedCostUsd: {
                answers: null,
                judge: null,
                total: null,
                embeddingIncluded: false,
            },
        },
        thresholds: {
            minRecallAtK: 0.75,
            minMrr: 0.7,
            minSourceHitRate: 0.75,
            minChunkWindowHitRate: 0.75,
            minGroundedness: 0.8,
            minCitationCoverage: 0.8,
            minRefusalCorrectness: 0.8,
            maxHallucinationRate: 0.2,
        },
        fixtures: [],
        ingestion: [],
        retrieval: observation.retrieval,
        answers: observation.answers,
    });

    assert.match(markdown, /Absolute quality passed: false/);
    assert.match(markdown, /Baseline regression passed: true/);
    assert.match(markdown, /Reference: baseline-rag-v1-required-2026-07-17/);
    assert.match(markdown, /Known gaps observed: .*rabbit-pursuit-paraphrase/);
});

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { Queue, type JobsOptions, type QueueOptions } from "bullmq";

export const BOOK_PROCESSING_QUEUE_NAME = "book-processing";
export const RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_QUEUE_NAME = "rag-rerank-shadow";
export const RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_CONCURRENCY = 2;
export const RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_MAX_STARTED_ATTEMPTS = 1;
export const DEFAULT_RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE = 30;

export type BookFileType = "epub" | "pdf";

export interface BookProcessingJobData {
    bookId: string;
    userId: string;
    fileKey: string;
    fileType: BookFileType;
}

export type BookProcessingQueue = Queue<BookProcessingJobData>;

export interface RagRerankShadowJobData {
    assistantMessageId: string;
    userMessageId: string;
    conversationId: string;
    bookId: string;
    userId: string;
}

export type RagRerankShadowQueue = Queue<RagRerankShadowJobData>;

const defaultJobOptions: JobsOptions = {
    attempts: 3,
    backoff: {
        type: "exponential",
        delay: 5000,
    },
    removeOnComplete: {
        age: 24 * 60 * 60,
        count: 1000,
    },
    removeOnFail: {
        age: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
        count: 5000,
    },
};

const shadowJobOptions: JobsOptions = {
    attempts: 1,
    removeOnComplete: {
        age: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
        count: 5000,
    },
    removeOnFail: {
        age: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
        count: 10000,
    },
};

export const getRedisConnectionOptions = () => {
    if (!process.env.REDIS_URL) {
        throw new Error("Missing required REDIS_URL environment variable");
    }

    return {
        url: process.env.REDIS_URL,
        maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
    };
};

export const getRedisProducerConnectionOptions = () => ({
    ...getRedisConnectionOptions(),
    maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
    enableOfflineQueue: false,
});

export const createBookProcessingQueue = (
    options: Omit<QueueOptions, "connection" | "defaultJobOptions"> = {}
) =>
    new Queue<BookProcessingJobData>(BOOK_PROCESSING_QUEUE_NAME, {
        ...options,
        connection: getRedisConnectionOptions(),
        defaultJobOptions,
    });

export const createBookProcessingJobId = (bookId: string) =>
    `book-processing-${bookId}`;

export const enqueueBookProcessingJob = async (
    queue: BookProcessingQueue,
    payload: BookProcessingJobData
) => {
    await queue.add("process-book", payload, {
        jobId: createBookProcessingJobId(payload.bookId),
    });
};

export const createRagRerankShadowQueue = (
    options: Omit<QueueOptions, "connection" | "defaultJobOptions"> = {}
) =>
    new Queue<RagRerankShadowJobData>(RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_QUEUE_NAME, {
        ...options,
        connection: getRedisProducerConnectionOptions(),
        defaultJobOptions: shadowJobOptions,
    });

export const createRagRerankShadowJobId = (assistantMessageId: string) =>
    `rag-rerank-shadow-${assistantMessageId}`;

export const enqueueRagRerankShadowJob = async (
    queue: RagRerankShadowQueue,
    payload: RagRerankShadowJobData
) => {
    await queue.add("compare-reranked-evidence", payload, {
        jobId: createRagRerankShadowJobId(payload.assistantMessageId),
    });
};

export const parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate = (
    value: string | undefined
) => {
    if (value === undefined || value === "") return 0;
    const parsed = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > 1) {
        throw new Error(
            "RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE must be a number from 0 to 1"
        );
    }
    return parsed;
};

export const parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit = (
    value: string | undefined
) => {
    if (value === undefined || value === "") {
        return DEFAULT_RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE;
    }
    const parsed = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < 1) {
        throw new Error(
            "RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE must be a positive integer"
        );
    }
    return parsed;
};

export const getRagRerankShadowSampleBucket = (
    assistantMessageId: string
) => {
    const digest = createHash("sha256")
        .update(assistantMessageId)
        .digest();
    return digest.readUInt32BE(0) / 0x1_0000_0000;
};

export const shouldSampleRagRerankShadow = (
    assistantMessageId: string,
    sampleRate: number
) => {
    if (sampleRate <= 0) return false;
    if (sampleRate >= 1) return true;
    return getRagRerankShadowSampleBucket(assistantMessageId) < sampleRate;
};
</file>

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import {
    RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_MAX_STARTED_ATTEMPTS,
    createRagRerankShadowJobId,
    getRagRerankShadowSampleBucket,
    parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate,
    parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit,
    shouldSampleRagRerankShadow,
} from "../src";

test("shadow jobs may start only once", () => {
    assert.equal(RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_MAX_STARTED_ATTEMPTS, 1);
});

test("shadow sampling defaults to disabled and validates decimal rates", () => {
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate(undefined), 0);
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate(""), 0);
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate("0.05"), 0.05);
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate("1"), 1);
    assert.throws(() => parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate("-0.1"), /0 to 1/);
    assert.throws(() => parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate("1.1"), /0 to 1/);
    assert.throws(() => parseRagRerankShadowSampleRate("invalid"), /0 to 1/);
});

test("shadow worker rate limit defaults to 30 and rejects invalid values", () => {
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit(undefined), 30);
    assert.equal(parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit("60"), 60);
    assert.throws(() => parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit("0"), /positive integer/);
    assert.throws(() => parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit("1.5"), /positive integer/);
});

test("shadow sampling is deterministic from the assistant message ID", () => {
    const messageId = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
    const bucket = getRagRerankShadowSampleBucket(messageId);
    assert.equal(bucket, getRagRerankShadowSampleBucket(messageId));
    assert.ok(bucket >= 0 && bucket < 1);
    assert.equal(shouldSampleRagRerankShadow(messageId, 0), false);
    assert.equal(shouldSampleRagRerankShadow(messageId, 1), true);
    assert.equal(
        shouldSampleRagRerankShadow(messageId, bucket + Number.EPSILON),
        true
    );
});

test("shadow jobs use a stable assistant-message job ID", () => {
    assert.equal(
        createRagRerankShadowJobId("assistant-1"),
        "rag-rerank-shadow-assistant-1"
    );
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import {

const chunks: BookSearchChunk[] = [

const createService = (semanticResults: VectorSearchResult[] = []) =>

test("minimum score filters weak single-channel hybrid matches", async () => {

    const results = await service.search("book_test", "bicycle", {
        vectorLimit: 0,
        minScore: 0.03,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(results, []);
});

test("minimum score keeps results with lexical and semantic agreement", async () => {
    const service = createService([
        {
            id: "book_test_0",
            content: chunks[0].content,
            rank: 1,
        },
        {
            id: "book_test_1",
            content: chunks[1].content,
            rank: 2,
        },
    ]);

    const results = await service.search("book_test", "rabbit", {
        minScore: 0.03,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(
        results.map((result) => result.id),
        ["book_test_0"]
    );
});

test("diagnostics preserve candidate and selected result ordering", async () => {
    const service = createService([
        {
            id: "book_test_0",
            content: chunks[0].content,
            rank: 2,
            distance: 0.2,
        },
        {

            content: chunks[1].content,
            rank: 1,
            distance: 0.1,
        },
    ]);

    const response = await service.searchWithDiagnostics(
        "book_test",
        "rabbit",
        { finalLimit: 2 }
    );
    const legacyResults = await service.search("book_test", "rabbit", {
        finalLimit: 2,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(response.results, legacyResults);
    assert.equal(response.diagnostics.mode, "hybrid");
    assert.deepEqual(
        response.diagnostics.vectorCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.id),
        ["book_test_0", "book_test_1"]
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
        response.diagnostics.selectedCandidates.map(
            (candidate) => candidate.id
        ),
        response.results.map((result) => result.id)
    );
    assert.ok(response.diagnostics.durationMs >= 0);
});
