import {
    pgTable,
    text,
    timestamp,
    uuid,
    pgEnum,
    integer,
    primaryKey,
    foreignKey,
    uniqueIndex,
    jsonb,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import type { BookSearchChunkMetadata } from "@reader/providers";
import type { MessageExecutionMetadata } from "../types/ragTelemetry";

export const messageRoleEnum = pgEnum("message_role", ["user", "assistant"]);
export const resourceTypeEnum = pgEnum("resource_type", ["book", "article"]);
export const fileTypeEnum = pgEnum("file_type", ["epub", "pdf"]);
export const messageCompletionStatusEnum = pgEnum("message_completion_status", [
    "complete",
    "truncated",
    "cancelled",
    "failed",
]);

export const Users = pgTable("users", {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    email: text("email").unique().notNull(),
    name: text("name").notNull(),
    image: text("image"),
    googleId: text("google_id").unique(),
    password: text("password"), // For future email+password auth
    username: text("username").unique(), // For future username support
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
});

// here, we call books the .epub and .pdf files
export const Books = pgTable("books", {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    title: text("title").notNull(),
    userId: uuid("user_id")
        .references(() => Users.id)
        .notNull(),
    fileKey: text("file_key").notNull(),
    fileType: fileTypeEnum("file_type"),
    collectionName: text("collection_name"),
    processingStatus: text("processing_status").default("processing").notNull(),
    processingError: text("processing_error"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
});

export const BookSearchChunks = pgTable(
    "book_search_chunks",
    {
        id: text("id").primaryKey(),
        collectionName: text("collection_name").notNull(),
        chunkIndex: integer("chunk_index").notNull(),
        content: text("content").notNull(),
        metadata: jsonb("metadata").$type<BookSearchChunkMetadata | null>(),
        createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
    },
    (table) => [
        uniqueIndex("book_search_chunks_collection_chunk_idx").on(
            table.collectionName,
            table.chunkIndex
        ),
    ]
);

export const Conversations = pgTable("conversations", {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    userId: uuid("user_id")
        .references(() => Users.id)
        .notNull(),
    title: text("title").notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
    lastMessageAt: timestamp("last_message_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
    resourceType: resourceTypeEnum("resource_type").notNull(),
    resourceId: uuid("resource_id").notNull(),
});

export type MessageContextSource = {
    id: string;
    chunkIndex: number;
    score: number;
    bestRank: number;
    rerankerRank?: number;
    rerankerScore?: number;
    selectionReason?: string;
    excerpt: string;
    metadata?: BookSearchChunkMetadata | null;
};

export const Messages = pgTable("messages", {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    conversationId: uuid("conversation_id")
        .references(() => Conversations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" })
        .notNull(),
    role: messageRoleEnum("role").notNull(),
    content: text("content").notNull(),
    contextSources: jsonb("context_sources").$type<
        MessageContextSource[] | null
    >(),
    completionStatus: messageCompletionStatusEnum("completion_status"),
    finishReason: text("finish_reason"),
    executionMetadata:
        jsonb("execution_metadata").$type<MessageExecutionMetadata | null>(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
});

export const Progress = pgTable(
    "progress",
    {
        userId: uuid("user_id").notNull(),
        bookId: uuid("book_id").notNull(),
        progressPosition: text("progress_position").notNull(),
        progressChapter: text("progress_chapter").notNull(),
        lastReadAt: timestamp("last_read_at", { withTimezone: true })
            .defaultNow()
            .notNull(),
        createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
            .defaultNow()
            .notNull(),
        updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
            .defaultNow()
            .notNull(),
    },
    (table) => [
        primaryKey({
            columns: [table.userId, table.bookId],
            name: "progress_user_id_book_id_pk",
        }),
        foreignKey({
            columns: [table.bookId],
            foreignColumns: [Books.id],
            name: "progress_book_id_books_id_fk",
        }).onDelete("cascade"),
        foreignKey({
            columns: [table.userId],
            foreignColumns: [Users.id],
            name: "progress_user_id_users_id_fk",
        }).onDelete("cascade"),
    ]
);

export type InsertUser = typeof Users.$inferInsert;
export type SelectUser = typeof Users.$inferSelect;
export type InsertBook = typeof Books.$inferInsert;
export type SelectBook = typeof Books.$inferSelect;

import { Request, Response, Router } from "express";
const router = Router();
import multer from "multer";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import {
    createLogger,
    deleteFile,
    getFile,
    uploadFile,
    vectorStore,
} from "@reader/providers";
import { authenticate } from "../middleware/auth";
import { db } from "../db";
import { Books, type SelectBook } from "../db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { bookSearchChunkStore } from "../services/BookSearchChunkStore";
import { hybridBookSearchService } from "../services/HybridBookSearchService";
import { handleBookProcessingEnqueue } from "../services/BookProcessingEnqueueService";
import { createOriginalUploadKey } from "../utils/uploadKeys";
import { asyncHandler } from "../middleware/asyncHandler";
import { createBookCollectionName } from "@reader/processing";
import { validateBookUpload } from "../utils/validateBookUpload";
import { uploadRateLimit } from "../middleware/rateLimit";

const log = createLogger("books");

const upload = multer({
    storage: multer.memoryStorage(),
    limits: {
        fileSize: 80 * 1024 * 1024, // 80 mb
    },
});

type BookFileRecord = Pick<
    SelectBook,
    "id" | "userId" | "fileKey" | "fileType"
>;

type BookFileDependencies = {
    findBookById(bookId: string): Promise<BookFileRecord | undefined>;
    getFile(fileKey: string): Promise<Buffer>;
};

const bookFileDependencies: BookFileDependencies = {
    async findBookById(bookId) {
        const [book] = await db
            .select()
            .from(Books)
            .where(eq(Books.id, bookId));
        return book;
    },
    getFile,
};

const getBookFileContentType = (book: BookFileRecord) => {
    if (book.fileType === "pdf") return "application/pdf";
    if (book.fileType === "epub") return "application/epub+zip";
    return "application/octet-stream";
};

export const handleGetBookFile = async (
    req: Request,
    res: Response,
    dependencies: BookFileDependencies = bookFileDependencies
) => {
    const bookId = req.params.id;

    try {
        const book = await dependencies.findBookById(bookId);
        if (!book) {
            res.status(404).json({ error: "Book was not found" });
            return;
        }

        if (book.userId !== req.user.id) {
            res.status(403).json({ error: "Not authorized" });
            return;
        }

        const fileBuffer = await dependencies.getFile(book.fileKey);
        res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "private");
        res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        res.type(getBookFileContentType(book));
        res.send(fileBuffer);
    } catch (er) {
        console.error("Error fetching file", er);
        res.status(500).json({ error: "Internal server error" });
    }
};

/**
 * @swagger
 * components:
 *   securitySchemes:
 *     bearerAuth:
 *       type: http
 *       scheme: bearer
 *       bearerFormat: JWT
 *   schemas:

 *       type: object

 *         id:
 *           type: string
 *           description: Unique identifier for the user
 *         name:
 *           type: string
 *           description: User's full name

 *           description: User's email address
 *         googleId:

 *           description: User's Google ID

 *           format: date-time

 *           type: string
 *           description: Unique identifier for the book
 *         title:
 *           type: string
 *           description: Book title
 *         userId:
 *           type: string
 *           description: ID of the user who uploaded the book
 *         fileKey:
 *           type: string
 *           description: Storage key for the book file
 *         createdAt:
 *           type: string
 *           format: date-time
 */

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/books:
 *   post:
 *     tags: [Books]
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     summary: Upload and process EPUB file
 *     description: Uploads an EPUB file, creates embeddings, and stores in ChromaDB
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         multipart/form-data:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             properties:
 *               file:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: binary
 *                 description: EPUB file to upload (max 80MB)
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: File successfully uploaded and processed
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "File upload successful"
 *                 book:
 *                   $ref: '#/components/schemas/Book'
 *                 collection:
 *                   type: string
 *                   description: ChromaDB collection name
 *                   example: "book_1ba8cd628f61"
 *       401:
 *         description: Authentication failed
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "No token provided or invalid token"
 *       400:
 *         description: Bad request
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 error:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "No file uploaded or invalid file format"
 *       413:
 *         description: Payload too large
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 error:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: "File size exceeds 80MB limit"
 */
router.post(
    "/",
    authenticate,
    uploadRateLimit,
    upload.single("file"),
    async (req, res) => {
        const requestStart = Date.now();
        log.info("Book upload request received", {
            userId: req.user.id,
            fileName: req.file?.originalname,
            mimeType: req.file?.mimetype,
        });
        try {
            if (!req.file) {
                log.warn("Book upload rejected: no file");
                res.status(400).json({ error: "No file uploaded" });
                return;
            }
            const fileBuffer = req.file.buffer;
            let fileType: "pdf" | "epub";
            try {
                fileType = await validateBookUpload(fileBuffer);
            } catch (error) {
                log.warn("Book upload rejected: unsupported file type", {
                    mimeType: req.file.mimetype,
                    userId: req.user.id,
                    error:
                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
                });
                res.status(400).json({
                    error: "Invalid PDF or EPUB file",
                });
                return;
            }
            const mimeType =
                fileType === "pdf" ? "application/pdf" : "application/epub+zip";
            const bookId = randomUUID();
            const fileKey = createOriginalUploadKey(req.user.id, bookId);

            log.info("Uploading file to storage", {
                userId: req.user.id,
                fileKey,
                mimeType,
            });
            await uploadFile(fileKey, fileBuffer);
            log.info("File uploaded to storage", {
                userId: req.user.id,
                fileKey,
            });
            const [book] = await db
                .insert(Books)
                .values({
                    id: bookId,
                    title: req.file.originalname,
                    userId: req.user.id,
                    fileKey,
                    fileType,
                    processingStatus: "processing",
                    processingError: null,
                })
                .returning();
            log.info("Book record created", {
                bookId: book.id,
                userId: req.user.id,
                fileKey,
                fileType,
            });

            try {
                await handleBookProcessingEnqueue({
                    bookId: book.id,
                    userId: book.userId,
                    fileKey: book.fileKey,
                    fileType,
                });
            } catch (error) {
                log.error("Book processing enqueue failed", {
                    bookId: book.id,
                    error:
                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
                });
                res.status(503).json({
                    error: "Book processing queue is unavailable",
                });
                return;
            }

            const [queuedBook] = await db
                .select()
                .from(Books)
                .where(eq(Books.id, book.id));

            const duration = Date.now() - requestStart;
            log.info("Book upload accepted", {
                bookId: book.id,
                durationMs: duration,
                fileKey,
            });
            res.status(202).json({
                message: "File upload accepted for processing",
                book: queuedBook ?? book,
                processStatus: "processing",
                fileType: mimeType,
            });
        } catch (e) {
            const duration = Date.now() - requestStart;
            log.error("Book upload failed", {
                userId: req.user.id,
                durationMs: duration,
                error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
            });
            res.status(500).json({ error: "Upload failed" });
        }
    }
);

/**
 * @swagger
 * tags:

router.get(

router.post(
    "/:id/retry",
    authenticate,
    asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
        const [book] = await db
            .select()
            .from(Books)
            .where(eq(Books.id, req.params.id));
        if (!book || book.userId !== req.user.id) {
            res.status(404).json({ error: "Book was not found" });

            !book.fileType ||
            !["queue_failed", "failed"].includes(book.processingStatus)
        ) {

        }
        await db
            .update(Books)
            .set({
                processingStatus: "processing",
                processingError: null,
            })
            .where(eq(Books.id, book.id));
        try {
            await handleBookProcessingEnqueue({
                bookId: book.id,
                userId: book.userId,
                fileKey: book.fileKey,
                fileType: book.fileType,
            });
        } catch {
            res.status(503).json({
                error: "Book processing queue is unavailable",
            });
            return;
        }
        res.status(202).json({ bookId: book.id, status: "processing" });
    })
);

// working
router.delete("/:id", authenticate, async (req, res) => {
    const bookId = req.params.id;
    log.info("Book delete request received", { bookId, userId: req.user.id });

    try {
        const [book] = await db
            .select()
            .from(Books)
            .where(eq(Books.id, bookId));
        if (!book) {
            log.warn("Book delete failed: not found", { bookId });
            res.status(404).json({
                error: "Book was not found",
            });
            return;
        }
        if (book.userId !== req.user.id) {
            log.warn("Book delete failed: unauthorized", {
                bookId,
                userId: req.user.id,
                ownerId: book.userId,
            });
            res.status(403).json({
                error: "Not authorized",
            });
            return;
        }
        await db
            .update(Books)
            .set({ processingStatus: "deleting" })
            .where(eq(Books.id, bookId));

        const [remaining] = await db
            .select({ count: sql`count(*)`.mapWith(Number) })
            .from(Books)
            .where(eq(Books.fileKey, book.fileKey));
        if (remaining.count <= 1) {
            log.info("Deleting orphaned file and collection", {
                fileKey: book.fileKey,
                collectionName: book.collectionName,
            });
            await deleteFile(book.fileKey);
        } else {
            log.debug("Skipping cleanup, file still referenced", {
                fileKey: book.fileKey,
                remainingCount: remaining.count,
            });
        }

        const collectionName =
            book.collectionName ?? createBookCollectionName(book.id);
        await vectorStore.deleteCollection(collectionName);
        await bookSearchChunkStore.deleteCollectionChunks(collectionName);
        hybridBookSearchService.clearCollectionCache(collectionName);

        await db.delete(Books).where(eq(Books.id, bookId));
        log.info("Book record deleted after cleanup", { bookId });

        log.info("Book delete successful", { bookId });
        res.status(204).send();
    } catch (e) {
        log.error("Book delete failed", {
            bookId,
            error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
        });
        res.status(500).json({
            error: "Failed to delete the file",
        });
    }
});
export default router;

import OpenAI from "openai";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import { observeOpenAI, type LangfuseConfig } from "@langfuse/openai";
import { isLangfuseTracingEnabled } from "../observability/langfuse";
import type {
    ChatCompletionCreateParamsStreaming,
    ChatCompletionMessageParam,
} from "openai/resources/chat/completions";

dotenv.config();

export type ChatMessage = {
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system";
    content: string;
};

export const OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS = [
    "gpt-4o-mini",
    "gpt-5.5-2026-04-23",
    "gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17",
] as const;
export type OpenAIChatModel = (typeof OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS)[number];
export const OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL: OpenAIChatModel = OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS[0];
export const OPENAI_CHAT_TEMPERATURE = 0.7;
export const OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS = 300;

export const isOpenAIChatModel = (model: unknown): model is OpenAIChatModel =>
    typeof model === "string" &&
    (OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS as readonly string[]).includes(model);

export const resolveStreamModelVersion = (
    requestedModel: string,
    streamedModel: unknown
) =>
    typeof streamedModel === "string" && streamedModel
        ? streamedModel
        : requestedModel;

const usesMaxCompletionTokens = (model: OpenAIChatModel) =>
    model !== OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL;

const getModelRequestParameters = (
    model: OpenAIChatModel
): Pick<
    ChatCompletionCreateParamsStreaming,
    "temperature" | "max_tokens" | "max_completion_tokens"
> => {
    if (usesMaxCompletionTokens(model)) {
        return { max_completion_tokens: OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS };
    }

    return {
        temperature: OPENAI_CHAT_TEMPERATURE,
        max_tokens: OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS,
    };
};

const getInstructionRole = (
    model: OpenAIChatModel
): ChatCompletionMessageParam["role"] =>
    model === OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL ? "system" : "developer";

export interface LangfuseOpenAITraceOptions {
    userId: string;
    sessionId: string;
    generationName: string;
    tags?: string[];
    generationMetadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
    parentSpanContext?: LangfuseConfig["parentSpanContext"];
}

export interface GenerateStreamResponseOptions {
    model?: OpenAIChatModel;
    temperature?: number;
    langfuse?: LangfuseOpenAITraceOptions;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export const createOpenAIClientOptions = (): NonNullable<
    ConstructorParameters<typeof OpenAI>[0]
> => {
    const openAiOptions: NonNullable<ConstructorParameters<typeof OpenAI>[0]> =
        {
            apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
            maxRetries: 0,
            defaultHeaders: {
                "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
            },
        };

    if (typeof globalThis.fetch === "function") {
        openAiOptions.fetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis) as NonNullable<
            typeof openAiOptions.fetch
        >;
    }

    return openAiOptions;
};

export const buildChatCompletionRequest = (
    userMessages: ChatMessage[],
    systemPrompt = "You are a helpful assistant.",
    model: OpenAIChatModel = OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL,
    temperature?: number
): ChatCompletionCreateParamsStreaming => {
    const modelParameters = getModelRequestParameters(model);
    if (temperature !== undefined && !usesMaxCompletionTokens(model)) {
        modelParameters.temperature = temperature;
    }
    return {
        model: model as ChatCompletionCreateParamsStreaming["model"],
        messages: [
            {
                role: getInstructionRole(model),
                content: systemPrompt,
                name: "system",
            } as ChatCompletionMessageParam,
            ...(userMessages as ChatCompletionMessageParam[]),
        ],
        ...modelParameters,
        stream: true,
        stream_options: {
            include_usage: true,
        },
    };
};

export class OpenAIService {
    private client: OpenAI;

    constructor(client?: OpenAI) {
        this.client = client ?? new OpenAI(createOpenAIClientOptions());
    }

    private getClient(options?: GenerateStreamResponseOptions) {
        if (!options?.langfuse || !isLangfuseTracingEnabled()) {
            return this.client;
        }

        return observeOpenAI(this.client, {
            traceName: "chat_with_book",
            userId: options.langfuse.userId,
            sessionId: options.langfuse.sessionId,
            tags: options.langfuse.tags,
            generationName: options.langfuse.generationName,
            generationMetadata: options.langfuse.generationMetadata,
            parentSpanContext: options.langfuse.parentSpanContext,
        });
    }

    async generateStreamResponse(
        userMessages: ChatMessage[],
        systemPrompt = "You are a helpful assistant.",
        options?: GenerateStreamResponseOptions
    ): Promise<any> {
        const response = await this.getClient(options).chat.completions.create(
            buildChatCompletionRequest(
                userMessages,
                systemPrompt,
                options?.model,
                options?.temperature
            ),
            { signal: options?.signal }
        );
        return response;
    }
    async generateResponse(context: string, query: string): Promise<string> {
        const response = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
            model: "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18",
            messages: [
                {
                    role: "system",
                    content:
                        "You are a helpful assistant. Answer the question based on the provided context.",
                },
                {
                    role: "user",
                    content: `Context:\n${context}\n\nQuestion: ${query}\n\nAnswer:`,
                },
            ],
            temperature: 0.7,
            max_tokens: 300,
        });

        return response.choices[0].message.content || "";
    }
}

import { Conversation } from "@/components/reader/ChatHistory";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import useSelectedConversation from "./useSelectedConversation";
import { Message } from "@/components/reader/MessageList";
import type { HighlightContext } from "@/types/highlightContext";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { conversationsQueryKey } from "./useConversations";

export interface ChatState {
    messages: Message[];
    isHistoryOpen: boolean;
    isExpanded: boolean;
    isChatOpen: boolean;
    currentConversation: Conversation | null;
}
export const initialChatState: ChatState = {
    messages: [],
    isHistoryOpen: false,
    isExpanded: false,
    isChatOpen: false,
    currentConversation: null,
};

export const useChat = (bookId: string) => {
    const [chatState, setChatState] = useState<ChatState>(initialChatState);
    const [input, setInput] = useState("");
    const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    const { data: selectedConversationData } = useSelectedConversation(
        chatState,
        bookId
    );

    const resetChat = useCallback(() => {
        setChatState(initialChatState);
        setInput("");
    }, []);

    const handleSelectConversation = useCallback(
        (conversation: Conversation) => {
            setChatState((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                currentConversation: conversation,
                isHistoryOpen: false,
                isChatOpen: true,
            }));
        },
        []
    );

    const startNewConversation = useCallback(() => {
        setChatState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            messages: [],
            currentConversation: null,
            isHistoryOpen: false,
            isChatOpen: true,
        }));
        setInput("");
    }, []);

    const toggleHistory = useCallback(
        (refetchConversations: () => Promise<void>) => {
            refetchConversations();
            setChatState((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                isHistoryOpen: !prev.isHistoryOpen,
                isChatOpen: true,
                isExpanded: true,
            }));
        },
        []
    );

    const handleMessageStream = useCallback(
        async (
            reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array>,
            setChatState: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<ChatState>>
        ) => {
            const textDecoder = new TextDecoder();
            let buffer = "";
            let conversationId: string | null = null;

            while (true) {
                const { done, value } = await reader.read();
                if (done) break;

                buffer += textDecoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
                const lines = buffer.split("\n");
                buffer = lines.pop() || "";

                for (const line of lines) {
                    const trimmedLine = line.trim();
                    if (!trimmedLine || !trimmedLine.startsWith("data: "))
                        continue;

                    const data = trimmedLine.slice(6).trim();
                    if (data === "[DONE]") continue;

                    try {
                        const jsonData = JSON.parse(data);
                        if (jsonData.type === "conversation_id") {
                            conversationId = jsonData.conversationId;
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (jsonData.type === "sources") {
                            setChatState((prev) => {
                                const messages = [...prev.messages];
                                const lastMessage =
                                    messages[messages.length - 1];

                                if (lastMessage?.role === "assistant") {
                                    messages[messages.length - 1] = {
                                        ...lastMessage,
                                        contextSources: Array.isArray(
                                            jsonData.sources
                                        )
                                            ? jsonData.sources
                                            : [],
                                    };
                                }

                                return {
                                    ...prev,
                                    messages,
                                    currentConversation:
                                        prev.currentConversation
                                            ? {
                                                  ...prev.currentConversation,
                                                  messages,
                                              }
                                            : null,
                                };
                            });
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (jsonData.type === "terminal") {
                            setChatState((prev) => {
                                const messages = [...prev.messages];
                                const lastMessage =
                                    messages[messages.length - 1];
                                if (lastMessage?.role === "assistant") {
                                    messages[messages.length - 1] = {
                                        ...lastMessage,
                                        completionStatus: jsonData.status,
                                    };
                                }
                                return { ...prev, messages };
                            });
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (jsonData.error !== undefined) {
                            setChatState((prev) => {
                                const messages = [...prev.messages];
                                const lastMessage =
                                    messages[messages.length - 1];

                                if (lastMessage?.role === "assistant") {
                                    messages[messages.length - 1] = {
                                        ...lastMessage,
                                        content: jsonData.error,
                                    };
                                }

                                return {
                                    ...prev,
                                    messages,
                                };
                            });
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (jsonData.content !== undefined) {
                            setChatState((prev) => {
                                const messages = [...prev.messages];
                                const lastMessage =
                                    messages[messages.length - 1];

                                if (lastMessage?.role === "assistant") {
                                    messages[messages.length - 1] = {
                                        ...lastMessage,
                                        content:
                                            lastMessage.content +
                                            jsonData.content,
                                    };
                                }

                                return {
                                    ...prev,
                                    messages,
                                    currentConversation:
                                        prev.currentConversation
                                            ? {
                                                  ...prev.currentConversation,
                                                  messages,
                                              }
                                            : null,
                                };
                            });
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error("Failed to parse SSE data:", e);
                    }
                }
            }
            return conversationId;
        },
        []
    );

    const handleSubmit = useCallback(
        async (
            e: React.FormEvent,
            model: string,
            highlightContext: HighlightContext | null = null,
            onHighlightContextSent?: () => void
        ) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!input.trim() || isSending) return;

            const userMessage = { id: null, role: "user", content: input };
            setInput("");
            setIsSending(true);

            try {
                const endpoint = chatState.currentConversation
                    ? `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/book/${bookId}/conversations/${chatState.currentConversation.id}/messages`
                    : `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/book/${bookId}/conversations`;

                setChatState((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    messages: [...prev.messages, userMessage],
                    isChatOpen: true,
                }));

                const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    },
                    credentials: "include",
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: userMessage.content,
                        model,
                        ...(highlightContext ? { highlightContext } : {}),
                    }),
                });

                if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Failed to send message");

                const reader = response.body?.getReader();
                if (!reader) throw new Error("No response stream");

                setChatState((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    messages: [
                        ...prev.messages,
                        { role: "assistant", content: "" },
                    ],
                }));

                const conversationId = await handleMessageStream(
                    reader,
                    setChatState
                );
                onHighlightContextSent?.();

                if (conversationId) {
                    setChatState((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        currentConversation: {
                            id: conversationId,
                            title: userMessage.content.substring(0, 50) + "...",
                            createdAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
                            messages: prev.messages,
                            lastMessageAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                        },
                    }));
                }

                await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
                    queryKey: conversationsQueryKey(bookId),
                });
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error:", error);
                setChatState((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    messages: [
                        ...prev.messages,
                        {
                            role: "assistant",
                            content:
                                "Sorry, there was an error processing your request.",
                        },
                    ],
                }));
            } finally {
                setIsSending(false);
            }
        },
        [input, isSending, chatState, bookId, handleMessageStream, queryClient]
    );

    // Update messages when selected conversation changes
    useEffect(() => {
        if (selectedConversationData) {
            setChatState((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                messages: selectedConversationData.messages,
            }));
        }
    }, [selectedConversationData]);

    const toggleExpanded = useCallback(() => {
        setChatState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            isExpanded: !prev.isExpanded,
        }));
    }, []);
    return {
        chatState,
        input,
        setInput,
        handleSubmit,
        handleSelectConversation,
        toggleHistory,
        toggleExpanded,
        resetChat,
        startNewConversation,
        setChatState,
        isSending,
    };
};
</file>

    {

    }
);

const shadowWorker = new Worker<RagRerankShadowJobData>(
    RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_QUEUE_NAME,
    (job) => processRagRerankShadowJob(job),
    {
        connection: getRedisConnectionOptions(),
        concurrency: RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_CONCURRENCY,
        maxStartedAttempts: RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_MAX_STARTED_ATTEMPTS,
        limiter: {
            max: parseRagRerankShadowRateLimit(
                process.env.RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
            ),
            duration: 60_000,
        },
    }
);

worker.on("completed", (job) => {
    console.log(`Book processing job ${job.id} completed`);
});

worker.on("failed", (job, error) => {
    console.error(`Book processing job ${job?.id ?? "unknown"} failed`, error);
});

shadowWorker.on("completed", (job) => {
    console.log(`RAG shadow job ${job.id} completed`);
});

shadowWorker.on("failed", (job, error) => {
    console.error(
        "RAG shadow job failed",
        getRagShadowFailureMetadata(job, error)
    );
});

const shutdown = async () => {
    console.log("Shutting down book processing worker");
    await Promise.all([worker.close(), shadowWorker.close()]);
    await Promise.all([shutdownLangfuseTracing(), closeDatabasePool()]);
    process.exit(0);
};

process.on("SIGTERM", () => {
    void shutdown();
});

process.on("SIGINT", () => {
    void shutdown();
});

console.log(
    `Book processing worker listening on ${BOOK_PROCESSING_QUEUE_NAME}`
);
console.log(`RAG shadow worker listening on ${RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_QUEUE_NAME}`);

export const DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17";

const unitIntervalEnv = (name: string, fallback: number) => {
    const parsed = Number(process.env[name]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;
    if (parsed < 0 || parsed > 1) {
        throw new Error(`${name} must be between 0 and 1`);
    }
    return parsed;
};

const integerEnv = (name: string, fallback: number) => {
    const parsed = Number(process.env[name]);
    return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
};

export const getEvalThresholds = (): EvalThresholds => ({
    minRecallAtK: unitIntervalEnv("RAG_EVAL_MIN_RECALL_AT_K", 0.75),
    minMrr: unitIntervalEnv("RAG_EVAL_MIN_MRR", 0.7),
    minSourceHitRate: unitIntervalEnv("RAG_EVAL_MIN_SOURCE_HIT_RATE", 0.75),
    minChunkWindowHitRate: unitIntervalEnv(
        "RAG_EVAL_MIN_CHUNK_WINDOW_HIT_RATE",
        0.75
    ),
    minGroundedness: unitIntervalEnv("RAG_EVAL_MIN_GROUNDEDNESS", 0.8),
    minCitationCoverage: unitIntervalEnv("RAG_EVAL_MIN_CITATION_COVERAGE", 0.8),
    minRefusalCorrectness: unitIntervalEnv(
        "RAG_EVAL_MIN_REFUSAL_CORRECTNESS",
        0.8
    ),
    maxHallucinationRate: unitIntervalEnv(
        "RAG_EVAL_MAX_HALLUCINATION_RATE",
        0.2
    ),
});

export const getJudgeModel = () =>
    process.env.RAG_EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL || DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL;

export const getJudgeMaxCases = () =>
    integerEnv("RAG_EVAL_JUDGE_MAX_CASES", 25);

export const getLangfuseDatasetName = () =>
    process.env.RAG_EVAL_LANGFUSE_DATASET || DEFAULT_DATASET_NAME;

export const hasOpenAiConfig = () => Boolean(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY);

export const hasLangfuseConfig = () =>
    Boolean(process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY && process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY);

export type EvalCommand = "live" | "ci" | "extended";

export const shouldFailEvalCommand = ({
    command,
    qualityPassed,
    regressionPassed,
}: {
    command: EvalCommand;
    qualityPassed: boolean;
    regressionPassed: boolean | null;
}) => {
    if (command === "ci") return regressionPassed !== true;
    if (command === "live") return !qualityPassed;

import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import type {
    EvalCategory,
    EvalSuite,
    ExpectedEvidenceAnchor,
    RagEvalCase,
} from "./types";

const DATASET_PATH = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../datasets/reader-rag-golden.jsonl"
);

const SUITES = new Set<EvalSuite>(["required", "extended"]);
const CATEGORIES = new Set<EvalCategory>([
    "factual",
    "paraphrase",
    "no_answer",
    "follow_up",
    "highlight",
    "summary",
    "comparison",
    "adversarial",
    "isolation",
]);

const validateEvidence = (
    value: unknown,
    caseId: string
): ExpectedEvidenceAnchor[] | undefined => {
    if (value === undefined) return undefined;
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || !value.length) {
        throw new Error(
            `Answerable dataset case ${caseId} requires expectedEvidence`
        );
    }
    return value.map((anchor, index) => {
        if (
            !anchor ||
            typeof anchor !== "object" ||
            typeof (anchor as ExpectedEvidenceAnchor).text !== "string" ||
            !(anchor as ExpectedEvidenceAnchor).text.trim()
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                `Dataset case ${caseId} evidence ${index + 1} requires text`
            );
        }
        const chapterTitle = (anchor as ExpectedEvidenceAnchor).chapterTitle;
        if (
            chapterTitle !== undefined &&
            (typeof chapterTitle !== "string" || !chapterTitle.trim())
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                `Dataset case ${caseId} evidence ${index + 1} has invalid chapterTitle`
            );
        }
        return anchor as ExpectedEvidenceAnchor;
    });
};

const validateMessages = (value: unknown, caseId: string) => {
    if (value === undefined) return undefined;
    if (
        !Array.isArray(value) ||
        value.some(
            (message) =>
                !message ||
                typeof message !== "object" ||
                !["system", "user", "assistant"].includes(
                    String((message as { role?: unknown }).role)
                ) ||
                typeof (message as { content?: unknown }).content !== "string"
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(`Dataset case ${caseId} has invalid priorMessages`);
    }
    return value as RagEvalCase["priorMessages"];
};

export const selectDatasetCases = (cases: RagEvalCase[], suite: EvalSuite) =>
    suite === "required"
        ? cases.filter((testCase) => testCase.suite === "required")
        : cases;

export const loadGoldenDataset = async (
    datasetPath = DATASET_PATH,
    suite: EvalSuite = "required"
): Promise<RagEvalCase[]> => {
    if (!SUITES.has(suite)) throw new Error(`Invalid eval suite: ${suite}`);
    const raw = await fs.readFile(datasetPath, "utf8");
    const cases = raw
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map((line) => line.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((line, index) => {
            let value: unknown;
            try {
                value = JSON.parse(line);
            } catch {
                throw new Error(`Invalid JSON on dataset line ${index + 1}`);
            }
            if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
                throw new Error(`Dataset line ${index + 1} must be an object`);
            }
            const testCase = value as Partial<RagEvalCase>;
            for (const field of [
                "id",
                "fixtureId",
                "question",
                "expectedAnswer",
            ] as const) {
                if (
                    typeof testCase[field] !== "string" ||
                    !testCase[field]!.trim()
                ) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Dataset line ${index + 1} requires ${field}`
                    );
                }
            }
            if (!SUITES.has(testCase.suite as EvalSuite)) {
                throw new Error(`Dataset line ${index + 1} has invalid suite`);
            }
            if (!CATEGORIES.has(testCase.category as EvalCategory)) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Dataset line ${index + 1} has invalid category`
                );
            }
            testCase.expectedEvidence = validateEvidence(
                testCase.expectedEvidence,
                testCase.id!
            );
            testCase.priorMessages = validateMessages(
                testCase.priorMessages,
                testCase.id!
            );
            if (testCase.highlightContext !== undefined) {
                if (
                    !testCase.highlightContext ||
                    testCase.highlightContext.sourceType !== "epub" ||
                    typeof testCase.highlightContext.text !== "string" ||
                    !testCase.highlightContext.text.trim()
                ) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Dataset case ${testCase.id} has invalid highlightContext`
                    );
                }
            }
            if (
                !testCase.noAnswerExpected &&
                !testCase.expectedEvidence?.length
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Answerable dataset case ${testCase.id} requires expectedEvidence`
                );
            }
            if (
                testCase.noAnswerExpected &&
                testCase.category !== "no_answer"
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    `No-answer dataset case ${testCase.id} must use category no_answer`
                );
            }
            return testCase as RagEvalCase;
        });

    const ids = new Set<string>();
    for (const testCase of cases) {
        if (ids.has(testCase.id)) {
            throw new Error(`Duplicate dataset case id: ${testCase.id}`);
        }
        ids.add(testCase.id);
    }
    if (!cases.length) throw new Error("RAG eval dataset is empty");
    const selected = selectDatasetCases(cases, suite);
    if (!selected.length) {
        throw new Error(`RAG eval ${suite} suite is empty`);
    }
    return selected;
};

<file path="packages/evals/src/rerankComparison.ts">
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { wordTrigramJaccard } from "@reader/api/rag";
import type {
    AnswerCaseResult,
    AnswerSummary,
    PreparedEvalCase,
    RagEvalCase,
    RagEvalFixture,
    RagEvalIngestion,
    RetrievalCaseResult,
    RetrievalSummary,
} from "./types";
import type { NormalizedModelUsage } from "@reader/api/ai-usage";

const REPORT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, "../reports");

const mean = (values: number[]) =>
    values.length
        ? values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length
        : 0;

export const percentile = (values: number[], quantile: number) => {
    if (!values.length) return 0;
    const sorted = [...values].sort((left, right) => left - right);
    return sorted[Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sorted.length * quantile) - 1)];
};

export const maxDuplicateSimilarity = (
    sources: PreparedEvalCase["sources"]
) => {
    let maximum = 0;
    for (let left = 0; left < sources.length; left += 1) {
        for (let right = left + 1; right < sources.length; right += 1) {
            maximum = Math.max(
                maximum,
                wordTrigramJaccard(
                    sources[left].excerpt,
                    sources[right].excerpt
                )
            );
        }
    }
    return maximum;
};

export const hasIdenticalEvidence = (
    baseline: PreparedEvalCase["sources"],
    reranked: PreparedEvalCase["sources"]
) =>
    baseline.length === reranked.length &&
    baseline.every(
        (source, index) =>
            source.id === reranked[index]?.id &&
            source.excerpt === reranked[index]?.excerpt
    );

const emptyUsage = (): NormalizedModelUsage => ({
    inputTokens: 0,
    cachedInputTokens: 0,
    outputTokens: 0,
    totalTokens: 0,
});

const sumUsage = (
    values: Array<NormalizedModelUsage | null>
): NormalizedModelUsage | null =>
    values.some((value) => value === null)
        ? null
        : values.reduce<NormalizedModelUsage>((total, value) => {
              total.inputTokens += value!.inputTokens;
              total.cachedInputTokens += value!.cachedInputTokens;
              total.outputTokens += value!.outputTokens;
              total.totalTokens += value!.totalTokens;
              return total;
          }, emptyUsage());

const sumCosts = (values: Array<number | null>) =>
    values.some((value) => value === null)
        ? null
        : values.reduce<number>((total, value) => total + value!, 0);

const delta = (reranked: number, baseline: number) => reranked - baseline;

type RetrievalEvaluation = {
    summary: RetrievalSummary;
    cases: RetrievalCaseResult[];
};

type AnswerEvaluation = {
    summary: AnswerSummary;
    cases: AnswerCaseResult[];
};

export interface RerankComparisonReport {
    runId: string;
    createdAt: string;
    infrastructurePassed: boolean;
    promotionPassed: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    answerModels: string[];
    fixtures: RagEvalFixture[];
    ingestion: RagEvalIngestion[];
    judgedAnswerCount: number;
    pairedRetrieval: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    pairedAnswers: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    aggregate: Record<string, unknown>;
    latencyMs: Record<string, { p50: number; p95: number }>;
    usage: Record<string, NormalizedModelUsage | null>;
    estimatedCostUsd: Record<string, number | null>;
    promotion: {
        checks: Record<string, boolean>;
        failedChecks: string[];
    };
}

const latencySummary = (values: number[]) => ({
    p50: percentile(values, 0.5),
    p95: percentile(values, 0.95),
});

export const assertRerankComparisonMatrix = ({
    cases,
    answerModels,
    pipelineVersions,
    maxJudgedAnswers,
}: {
    cases: RagEvalCase[];
    answerModels: string[];
    pipelineVersions: string[];
    maxJudgedAnswers: number;
}) => {
    const judgedAnswerCount =
        cases.length * answerModels.length * pipelineVersions.length;
    if (
        cases.length !== 7 ||
        new Set(cases.map((testCase) => testCase.id)).size !== 7 ||
        cases.some((testCase) => testCase.suite !== "required")
    ) {
        throw new Error("Rerank comparison requires exactly 7 required cases");
    }
    if (answerModels.length !== 3 || new Set(answerModels).size !== 3) {
        throw new Error("Rerank comparison requires exactly 3 answer models");
    }
    if (
        pipelineVersions.length !== 2 ||
        !pipelineVersions.includes("baseline-rag-v1") ||
        !pipelineVersions.includes("rerank-rag-v1")
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Rerank comparison requires baseline-rag-v1 and rerank-rag-v1"
        );
    }
    if (judgedAnswerCount !== 42 || judgedAnswerCount > maxJudgedAnswers) {
        throw new Error(
            `Rerank comparison requires exactly 42 judged answers under cap ${maxJudgedAnswers}`
        );
    }
    return judgedAnswerCount;
};

export const assertPreparedRerankMatrix = ({
    baselineCases,
    rerankedCases,
    answerModels,
    maxJudgedAnswers,
}: {
    baselineCases: PreparedEvalCase[];
    rerankedCases: PreparedEvalCase[];
    answerModels: string[];
    maxJudgedAnswers: number;
}) => {
    const validatePipeline = (
        cases: PreparedEvalCase[],
        pipelineVersion: string
    ) => {
        const ids = new Set(cases.map((testCase) => testCase.id));
        if (
            cases.length !== 21 ||
            ids.size !== 7 ||
            cases.some(
                (testCase) =>
                    testCase.suite !== "required" ||
                    testCase.pipelineVersion !== pipelineVersion
            )
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                `${pipelineVersion} requires 21 generated answers across 7 required cases`
            );
        }
        for (const id of ids) {
            const models = cases
                .filter((testCase) => testCase.id === id)
                .map((testCase) => testCase.answerModel);
            if (
                models.length !== 3 ||
                new Set(models).size !== 3 ||
                answerModels.some((model) => !models.includes(model))
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    `${pipelineVersion} case ${id} requires all 3 answer models`
                );
            }
        }
    };
    validatePipeline(baselineCases, "baseline-rag-v1");
    validatePipeline(rerankedCases, "rerank-rag-v1");
    const total = baselineCases.length + rerankedCases.length;
    if (total !== 42 || total > maxJudgedAnswers || total > 50) {
        throw new Error(
            `Rerank comparison requires 42 generated answers under cap ${Math.min(maxJudgedAnswers, 50)}`
        );
    }
    return total;
};

export const createRerankComparisonReport = ({
    baselineRetrieval,
    rerankedRetrieval,
    baselineAnswers,
    rerankedAnswers,
    baselineCases,
    rerankedCases,
    fixtures,
    ingestion,
    answerModels,
}: {
    baselineRetrieval: RetrievalEvaluation;
    rerankedRetrieval: RetrievalEvaluation;
    baselineAnswers: AnswerEvaluation;
    rerankedAnswers: AnswerEvaluation;
    baselineCases: PreparedEvalCase[];
    rerankedCases: PreparedEvalCase[];
    fixtures: RagEvalFixture[];
    ingestion: RagEvalIngestion[];
    answerModels: string[];
}): RerankComparisonReport => {
    const uniqueBaselineCases = [
        ...new Map(
            baselineCases.map((testCase) => [testCase.id, testCase])
        ).values(),
    ];
    const uniqueRerankedCases = [
        ...new Map(
            rerankedCases.map((testCase) => [testCase.id, testCase])
        ).values(),
    ];
    const baselineRetrievalById = new Map(
        baselineRetrieval.cases.map((result) => [result.id, result])
    );
    const rerankedRetrievalById = new Map(
        rerankedRetrieval.cases.map((result) => [result.id, result])
    );
    const baselinePreparedById = new Map(
        uniqueBaselineCases.map((result) => [result.id, result])
    );
    const rerankedPreparedById = new Map(
        uniqueRerankedCases.map((result) => [result.id, result])
    );
    const pairedRetrieval = [...baselineRetrievalById.entries()].map(
        ([id, baseline]) => {
            const reranked = rerankedRetrievalById.get(id);
            const baselinePrepared = baselinePreparedById.get(id);
            const rerankedPrepared = rerankedPreparedById.get(id);
            if (!reranked || !baselinePrepared || !rerankedPrepared) {
                throw new Error(`Missing paired retrieval result for ${id}`);
            }
            const baselineDuplicate = maxDuplicateSimilarity(
                baselinePrepared.sources
            );
            const rerankedDuplicate = maxDuplicateSimilarity(
                rerankedPrepared.sources
            );
            return {
                id,
                baseline: {
                    recallAtK: baseline.recallAtK,
                    evidenceCoverage: baseline.evidenceCoverage,
                    reciprocalRank: baseline.reciprocalRank,
                    duplicateSimilarity: baselineDuplicate,
                    passed: baseline.passed,
                },
                reranked: {
                    recallAtK: reranked.recallAtK,
                    evidenceCoverage: reranked.evidenceCoverage,
                    reciprocalRank: reranked.reciprocalRank,
                    duplicateSimilarity: rerankedDuplicate,
                    passed: reranked.passed,
                },
                delta: {
                    recallAtK: delta(reranked.recallAtK, baseline.recallAtK),
                    evidenceCoverage: delta(
                        reranked.evidenceCoverage,
                        baseline.evidenceCoverage
                    ),
                    reciprocalRank: delta(
                        reranked.reciprocalRank,
                        baseline.reciprocalRank
                    ),
                    duplicateSimilarity: delta(
                        rerankedDuplicate,
                        baselineDuplicate
                    ),
                },
            };
        }
    );

    const answerKey = (result: AnswerCaseResult) =>
        `${result.id}:${result.answerModel}`;
    const rerankedAnswerByKey = new Map(
        rerankedAnswers.cases.map((result) => [answerKey(result), result])
    );
    const pairedAnswers = baselineAnswers.cases.map((baseline) => {
        const reranked = rerankedAnswerByKey.get(answerKey(baseline));
        if (!reranked) {
            throw new Error(
                `Missing paired answer result for ${answerKey(baseline)}`
            );
        }
        const baselinePrepared = baselinePreparedById.get(baseline.id);
        const rerankedPrepared = rerankedPreparedById.get(reranked.id);
        if (!baselinePrepared || !rerankedPrepared) {
            throw new Error(
                `Missing paired prepared answer context for ${answerKey(baseline)}`
            );
        }
        const evidenceIdentical = hasIdenticalEvidence(
            baselinePrepared.sources,
            rerankedPrepared.sources
        );
        return {
            id: baseline.id,
            answerModel: baseline.answerModel,
            evidenceIdentical,
            baseline: { scores: baseline.scores, passed: baseline.passed },
            reranked: { scores: reranked.scores, passed: reranked.passed },
            delta: {
                groundedness: delta(
                    reranked.scores.groundedness,
                    baseline.scores.groundedness
                ),
                citationCoverage: delta(
                    reranked.scores.citationCoverage,
                    baseline.scores.citationCoverage
                ),
                refusalCorrectness: delta(
                    reranked.scores.refusalCorrectness,
                    baseline.scores.refusalCorrectness
                ),
                hallucinationRate: delta(
                    reranked.scores.hallucinationRate,
                    baseline.scores.hallucinationRate
                ),
            },
        };
    });

    const baselineDuplicateValues = pairedRetrieval.map(
        (pair) =>
            (pair.baseline as { duplicateSimilarity: number })
                .duplicateSimilarity
    );
    const rerankedDuplicateValues = pairedRetrieval.map(
        (pair) =>
            (pair.reranked as { duplicateSimilarity: number })
                .duplicateSimilarity
    );
    const rerankerDiagnostics = uniqueRerankedCases.map((testCase) => {
        const diagnostics = testCase.retrievalDiagnostics;
        if (diagnostics?.mode !== "reranked") {
            throw new Error(`Missing reranker diagnostics for ${testCase.id}`);
        }
        return diagnostics.reranker;
    });
    const successfulRerankerDiagnostics = rerankerDiagnostics.filter(
        (diagnostic) => diagnostic.status === "success"
    );
    const knownSuccessfulRerankerCosts = successfulRerankerDiagnostics
        .map((diagnostic) => diagnostic.estimatedCost?.amount ?? null)
        .filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
    const successfulRerankerCostsAreComplete =
        successfulRerankerDiagnostics.length > 0 &&
        knownSuccessfulRerankerCosts.length ===
            successfulRerankerDiagnostics.length;
    const highDuplicateReductionPassed = pairedRetrieval
        .filter(
            (pair) =>
                (pair.baseline as { duplicateSimilarity: number })
                    .duplicateSimilarity > 0.85
        )
        .every((pair) => {
            const baseline = (pair.baseline as { duplicateSimilarity: number })
                .duplicateSimilarity;
            const reranked = (pair.reranked as { duplicateSimilarity: number })
                .duplicateSimilarity;
            return reranked <= baseline * 0.9;
        });
    const noRequiredCaseLost =
        pairedRetrieval.every(
            (pair) =>
                !(pair.baseline as { passed: boolean }).passed ||
                (pair.reranked as { passed: boolean }).passed
        ) &&
        pairedAnswers.every(
            (pair) =>
                !(pair.baseline as { passed: boolean }).passed ||
                (pair.reranked as { passed: boolean }).passed ||
                (pair as { evidenceIdentical: boolean }).evidenceIdentical
        );
    const rerankerFallbackCount = rerankerDiagnostics.filter(
        (diagnostic) => diagnostic.status === "fallback"
    ).length;
    const rerankerLatencies = rerankerDiagnostics.map(
        (diagnostic) => diagnostic.durationMs
    );
    const checks = {
        noRequiredCaseLost,
        recallAtKNonRegression:
            rerankedRetrieval.summary.recallAtK >=
            baselineRetrieval.summary.recallAtK,
        evidenceCoverageNonRegression:
            rerankedRetrieval.summary.evidenceCoverage >=
            baselineRetrieval.summary.evidenceCoverage,
        mrrNonRegression:
            rerankedRetrieval.summary.mrr >= baselineRetrieval.summary.mrr,
        groundednessBudget:
            rerankedAnswers.summary.groundedness >=
            baselineAnswers.summary.groundedness - 0.05,
        citationCoverageBudget:
            rerankedAnswers.summary.citationCoverage >=
            baselineAnswers.summary.citationCoverage - 0.05,
        refusalCorrectnessBudget:
            rerankedAnswers.summary.refusalCorrectness >=
            baselineAnswers.summary.refusalCorrectness - 0.05,
        hallucinationBudget:
            rerankedAnswers.summary.hallucinationRate <=
            baselineAnswers.summary.hallucinationRate + 0.05,
        duplicateSimilarityNonIncrease:
            mean(rerankedDuplicateValues) <= mean(baselineDuplicateValues),
        highDuplicateReduction: highDuplicateReductionPassed,
        zeroLiveRerankerFallbacks: rerankerFallbackCount === 0,
        rerankerP95AtMost2500Ms: percentile(rerankerLatencies, 0.95) <= 2_500,
        rerankerCostAtMost0015:
            successfulRerankerCostsAreComplete &&
            knownSuccessfulRerankerCosts.every((cost) => cost <= 0.015),
    };
    const failedChecks = Object.entries(checks)
        .filter(([, passed]) => !passed)
        .map(([name]) => name);
    const baselineAnswerCosts = baselineAnswers.cases.map(
        (result) => result.answerEstimatedCost?.amount ?? null
    );
    const rerankedAnswerCosts = rerankedAnswers.cases.map(
        (result) => result.answerEstimatedCost?.amount ?? null
    );
    const baselineJudgeCosts = baselineAnswers.cases.map(
        (result) => result.judgeEstimatedCost?.amount ?? null
    );
    const rerankedJudgeCosts = rerankedAnswers.cases.map(
        (result) => result.judgeEstimatedCost?.amount ?? null
    );
    const rerankerCosts = rerankerDiagnostics.map(
        (diagnostic) => diagnostic.estimatedCost?.amount ?? null
    );

    return {
        runId: `rerank-comparison-${Date.now()}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        infrastructurePassed: true,
        promotionPassed: failedChecks.length === 0,
        error: null,
        answerModels,
        fixtures,
        ingestion,
        judgedAnswerCount:
            baselineAnswers.cases.length + rerankedAnswers.cases.length,
        pairedRetrieval,
        pairedAnswers,
        aggregate: {
            baseline: {
                retrieval: baselineRetrieval.summary,
                answers: baselineAnswers.summary,
                duplicateSimilarity: mean(baselineDuplicateValues),
            },
            reranked: {
                retrieval: rerankedRetrieval.summary,
                answers: rerankedAnswers.summary,
                duplicateSimilarity: mean(rerankedDuplicateValues),
                fallbackRate:
                    rerankerFallbackCount / rerankerDiagnostics.length,
            },
            delta: {
                recallAtK: delta(
                    rerankedRetrieval.summary.recallAtK,
                    baselineRetrieval.summary.recallAtK
                ),
                evidenceCoverage: delta(
                    rerankedRetrieval.summary.evidenceCoverage,
                    baselineRetrieval.summary.evidenceCoverage
                ),
                mrr: delta(
                    rerankedRetrieval.summary.mrr,
                    baselineRetrieval.summary.mrr
                ),
                groundedness: delta(
                    rerankedAnswers.summary.groundedness,
                    baselineAnswers.summary.groundedness
                ),
                citationCoverage: delta(
                    rerankedAnswers.summary.citationCoverage,
                    baselineAnswers.summary.citationCoverage
                ),
                refusalCorrectness: delta(
                    rerankedAnswers.summary.refusalCorrectness,
                    baselineAnswers.summary.refusalCorrectness
                ),
                hallucinationRate: delta(
                    rerankedAnswers.summary.hallucinationRate,
                    baselineAnswers.summary.hallucinationRate
                ),
                duplicateSimilarity: delta(
                    mean(rerankedDuplicateValues),
                    mean(baselineDuplicateValues)
                ),
            },
        },
        latencyMs: {
            baselineRetrieval: latencySummary(
                uniqueBaselineCases.map(
                    (testCase) => testCase.retrievalDurationMs
                )
            ),
            rerankedFirstStage: latencySummary(
                uniqueRerankedCases.map((testCase) => {
                    const diagnostics = testCase.retrievalDiagnostics;
                    return diagnostics?.mode === "reranked"
                        ? diagnostics.firstStage.durationMs
                        : 0;
                })
            ),
            reranker: latencySummary(rerankerLatencies),
            rerankedRetrieval: latencySummary(
                uniqueRerankedCases.map(
                    (testCase) => testCase.retrievalDurationMs
                )
            ),
            baselineAnswer: latencySummary(
                baselineAnswers.cases.map(
                    (result) => result.generationDurationMs
                )
            ),
            rerankedAnswer: latencySummary(
                rerankedAnswers.cases.map(
                    (result) => result.generationDurationMs
                )
            ),
            baselineJudge: latencySummary(
                baselineAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.judgeDurationMs)
            ),
            rerankedJudge: latencySummary(
                rerankedAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.judgeDurationMs)
            ),
        },
        usage: {
            reranker: sumUsage(
                rerankerDiagnostics.map((diagnostic) => diagnostic.usage)
            ),
            baselineAnswers: sumUsage(
                baselineAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.answerUsage)
            ),
            rerankedAnswers: sumUsage(
                rerankedAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.answerUsage)
            ),
            baselineJudge: sumUsage(
                baselineAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.judgeUsage)
            ),
            rerankedJudge: sumUsage(
                rerankedAnswers.cases.map((result) => result.judgeUsage)
            ),
        },
        estimatedCostUsd: {
            reranker: sumCosts(rerankerCosts),
            baselineAnswers: sumCosts(baselineAnswerCosts),
            rerankedAnswers: sumCosts(rerankedAnswerCosts),
            baselineJudge: sumCosts(baselineJudgeCosts),
            rerankedJudge: sumCosts(rerankedJudgeCosts),
            total: sumCosts([
                ...rerankerCosts,
                ...baselineAnswerCosts,
                ...rerankedAnswerCosts,
                ...baselineJudgeCosts,
                ...rerankedJudgeCosts,
            ]),
        },
        promotion: { checks, failedChecks },
    };
};

export const createInfrastructureFailureReport = (
    error: unknown
): RerankComparisonReport => ({
    runId: `rerank-comparison-${Date.now()}`,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    infrastructurePassed: false,
    promotionPassed: false,
    error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    answerModels: [],
    fixtures: [],
    ingestion: [],
    judgedAnswerCount: 0,
    pairedRetrieval: [],
    pairedAnswers: [],
    aggregate: {},
    latencyMs: {},
    usage: {},
    estimatedCostUsd: {},
    promotion: {
        checks: { infrastructurePassed: false },
        failedChecks: ["infrastructurePassed"],
    },
});

const formatNumber = (value: unknown) =>
    typeof value === "number" ? value.toFixed(4) : "n/a";

export const renderRerankComparisonMarkdown = (
    report: RerankComparisonReport
) => {
    const aggregate = report.aggregate as {
        baseline?: { duplicateSimilarity?: number };
        reranked?: { duplicateSimilarity?: number; fallbackRate?: number };
        delta?: Record<string, number>;
    };
    return (
        [
            "# Reader Reranking Comparison",
            "",
            `- Run: ${report.runId}`,
            `- Infrastructure passed: ${report.infrastructurePassed}`,
            `- Promotion passed: ${report.promotionPassed}`,
            `- Judged answers: ${report.judgedAnswerCount}`,
            `- Error: ${report.error ?? "none"}`,
            `- Reranker p50/p95: ${report.latencyMs.reranker?.p50 ?? 0}/${report.latencyMs.reranker?.p95 ?? 0} ms`,
            `- Reranker fallback rate: ${formatNumber(aggregate.reranked?.fallbackRate)}`,
            `- Baseline/reranked duplicate similarity: ${formatNumber(aggregate.baseline?.duplicateSimilarity)}/${formatNumber(aggregate.reranked?.duplicateSimilarity)}`,
            `- Estimated reranker cost: ${formatNumber(report.estimatedCostUsd.reranker)}`,
            `- Estimated total cost: ${formatNumber(report.estimatedCostUsd.total)}`,
            "",
            "## Stage latency p50/p95",
            "",
            ...Object.entries(report.latencyMs).map(
                ([stage, latency]) =>
                    `- ${stage}: ${latency.p50}/${latency.p95} ms`
            ),
            "",
            "## Usage",
            "",
            ...Object.entries(report.usage).map(
                ([stage, usage]) =>
                    `- ${stage}: ${usage === null ? "unknown" : JSON.stringify(usage)}`
            ),
            "",
            "## Estimated costs USD",
            "",
            ...Object.entries(report.estimatedCostUsd).map(
                ([stage, cost]) => `- ${stage}: ${formatNumber(cost)}`
            ),
            "",
            "## Promotion checks",
            "",
            ...Object.entries(report.promotion.checks).map(
                ([name, passed]) => `- ${name}: ${passed}`
            ),
            "",
            "## Aggregate deltas",
            "",
            ...Object.entries(aggregate.delta ?? {}).map(
                ([name, value]) => `- ${name}: ${formatNumber(value)}`
            ),
            "",
            "## Paired retrieval deltas",
            "",
            ...report.pairedRetrieval.map(
                (pair) => `- ${String(pair.id)}: ${JSON.stringify(pair.delta)}`
            ),
            "",
            "## Paired answer deltas",
            "",
            ...report.pairedAnswers.map(
                (pair) =>
                    `- ${String(pair.id)} / ${String(pair.answerModel)}: ${JSON.stringify(pair.delta)}`
            ),
        ].join("\n") + "\n"
    );
};

export const writeRerankComparisonReport = async (
    report: RerankComparisonReport
) => {
    await fs.mkdir(REPORT_DIR, { recursive: true });
    const jsonPath = path.join(REPORT_DIR, "latest-rerank-comparison.json");
    const markdownPath = path.join(REPORT_DIR, "latest-rerank-comparison.md");
    await fs.writeFile(jsonPath, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`);
    await fs.writeFile(markdownPath, renderRerankComparisonMarkdown(report));
    return { jsonPath, markdownPath };
};

export const writeInfrastructureFailureReport = async (error: unknown) => {
    const report = createInfrastructureFailureReport(error);
    const paths = await writeRerankComparisonReport(report);
    return { report, paths };
};
