test("prefers the concrete model version from stream chunks", () => {
    assert.equal(
        resolveStreamModelVersion("gpt-4o-mini", "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18"),
        "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18"
    );
    assert.equal(
        resolveStreamModelVersion("gpt-4o-mini", undefined),
        "gpt-4o-mini"
    );
});

test("chat stream request includes usage capture and model settings", () => {
    const request = buildChatCompletionRequest(messages);

    assert.equal(request.model, OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL);
    assert.equal(request.temperature, OPENAI_CHAT_TEMPERATURE);
    assert.equal(request.max_tokens, OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS);
    assert.equal(request.stream, true);
    assert.deepEqual(request.stream_options, { include_usage: true });
    assert.equal(request.messages.length, 2);
    assert.equal(request.messages[0].role, "system");
    assert.equal(request.messages[1].role, "user");
});

test("newer chat models use compatible request parameters", () => {
    for (const model of [
        "gpt-5.5-2026-04-23",
        "gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17",
    ] as const) {
        const request = buildChatCompletionRequest(messages, undefined, model);

        assert.equal(request.model, model);
        assert.equal(request.max_completion_tokens, OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS);
        assert.equal(request.max_tokens, undefined);
        assert.equal(request.temperature, undefined);
        assert.equal(request.messages[0].role, "developer");
    }
});

test("chat stream request accepts deterministic temperature", () => {
    const request = buildChatCompletionRequest(
        messages,
        undefined,
        OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL,
        0
    );

    assert.equal(request.temperature, 0);
});

test("OpenAI client options preserve transport hardening", () => {
    const options = createOpenAIClientOptions();

    assert.equal(options.maxRetries, 0);
    assert.deepEqual(options.defaultHeaders, {
        "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
    });
    if (typeof globalThis.fetch === "function") {
        assert.equal(typeof options.fetch, "function");
    }
});

test("stream generation sends the usage-enabled request to the configured client", async () => {
    const previousPublicKey = process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY;
    const previousSecretKey = process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY;
    delete process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY;
    delete process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY;

    const calls: unknown[] = [];
    const fakeStream = {} as AsyncIterable<unknown>;
    const fakeClient = {
        chat: {
            completions: {
                create: async (request: unknown) => {
                    calls.push(request);
                    return fakeStream;
                },
            },
        },
    } as unknown as OpenAI;

    try {
        const service = new OpenAIService(fakeClient);
        const result = await service.generateStreamResponse(messages);

        assert.equal(result, fakeStream);
        assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
        assert.deepEqual(
            (calls[0] as { stream_options?: unknown }).stream_options,
            { include_usage: true }
        );
    } finally {
        restoreEnv("LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY", previousPublicKey);
        restoreEnv("LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY", previousSecretKey);
    }
});

test("RAG pipeline configuration rejects unregistered behavior versions", () => {
    const previous = process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION;
    process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = "imaginary-rag-v9";
    try {
        assert.throws(getRagPipeline, /Unsupported RAG pipeline version/);
    } finally {
        if (previous === undefined) delete process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION;
        else process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = previous;
    }
});

test("RAG pipeline configuration rejects inherited object properties", () => {
    const previous = process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION;
    try {
        for (const inheritedProperty of ["constructor", "toString"]) {
            process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = inheritedProperty;
            assert.throws(
                getRagPipeline,
                new RegExp(
                    `Unsupported RAG pipeline version: ${inheritedProperty}`
                )
            );
        }
    } finally {
        restoreEnv("RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION", previous);
    }
});

test("RAG reranker model configuration rejects unknown and inherited keys", () => {
    const previous = process.env.RAG_RERANKER_MODEL;
    try {
        for (const invalid of ["unknown-model", "constructor", "toString"]) {
            process.env.RAG_RERANKER_MODEL = invalid;
            assert.throws(
                getRerankerModel,
                new RegExp(`Unsupported RAG reranker model: ${invalid}`)
            );
        }
    } finally {
        restoreEnv("RAG_RERANKER_MODEL", previous);
    }
});

test("baseline pipelines ignore unused reranker model configuration", () => {
    const previousPipeline = process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION;
    const previousReranker = process.env.RAG_RERANKER_MODEL;
    try {
        process.env.RAG_RERANKER_MODEL = "unknown-model";
        process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = "baseline-rag-v1";
        assert.equal(getRagPipeline().retrievalStrategy, "baseline");

        process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = "rerank-rag-v1";
        assert.throws(getRagPipeline, /Unsupported RAG reranker model/);
    } finally {
        restoreEnv("RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION", previousPipeline);
        restoreEnv("RAG_RERANKER_MODEL", previousReranker);
    }
});

test("registers the reranked pipeline and pinned prompt/model versions", () => {
    const previous = process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION;
    process.env.RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION = "rerank-rag-v1";
    try {
        assert.deepEqual(getRagPipeline(), {
            pipelineVersion: "rerank-rag-v1",
            retrievalStrategy: "reranked",
            promptVersion: "book-context-v1",
            answerPromptVersion: "book-context-v1",
            rerankerPromptVersion: "rerank-documents-v1",
            rerankerModel: "gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17",
        });
    } finally {
        restoreEnv("RAG_PIPELINE_VERSION", previous);
    }
});

test("normalizes chat usage and estimates versioned model cost", () => {
    const usage = normalizeModelUsage({
        prompt_tokens: 1_000,
        completion_tokens: 500,
        total_tokens: 1_500,
        prompt_tokens_details: { cached_tokens: 200 },
    });

    assert.deepEqual(usage, {
        inputTokens: 1_000,
        cachedInputTokens: 200,
        outputTokens: 500,
        totalTokens: 1_500,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(estimateModelCost("gpt-4o-mini", usage), {
        currency: "USD",
        amount: 0.000435,
        pricingVersion: "openai-standard-2026-07-16",
        sourceUrl: "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4o-mini",
    });
    assert.equal(estimateModelCost("unknown-model", usage), null);
});

import { and, asc, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { createLogger } from "@reader/providers";
import { db } from "../db";
import {
    Conversations,
    Books,
    Messages,
    type MessageContextSource,
} from "../db/schema";
import { authenticate } from "../middleware/auth";
import {
    OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS,
    OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL,
    OPENAI_CHAT_TEMPERATURE,
    type ChatMessage,
    type OpenAIChatModel,
    isOpenAIChatModel,
} from "../services/OpenAIServices";
import {
    addHighlightContextMessage,
    buildRetrievalQuery,
    normalizeHighlightContext,
    type HighlightContext,
} from "../services/HighlightContext";
import { Router, Request, Response } from "express";
import { chatRateLimit } from "../middleware/rateLimit";
import {
    appendSubmittedUserMessage,
    buildUserMessageInsert,
    getSubmittedUserMessage,
    toChatHistory,
} from "../services/ChatServerHistory";
import {
    getNoopTraceObservation,
    recordObservationError,
    withBookChatTrace,
    type TraceObservation,
} from "../observability/langfuse";
import {
    generateBookAnswer,
    retrieveBookContext,
} from "../services/BookRagService";
import {
    authorizeChatResource,
    createAuthorizedChatConversation,
    isSupportedChatResourceType,
} from "../services/ChatResourceAuthorization";
import {
    buildMessageExecutionMetadata,
    PUBLIC_MESSAGE_SELECTION,
} from "../services/ChatExecutionMetadata";
import type { MessageExecutionMetadata } from "../types/ragTelemetry";
import { maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow } from "../services/RagShadowEnqueueService";

const router = Router();
const log = createLogger("chat");

const chatResourceRepository = {
    findBookById: async (resourceId: string) => {
        const [book] = await db
            .select({
                id: Books.id,
                userId: Books.userId,
            })
            .from(Books)
            .where(eq(Books.id, resourceId));

        return book ?? null;
    },
    createConversation: async ({
        userId,
        title,
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
    }: {
        userId: string;
        title: string;
        resourceType: "book";
        resourceId: string;
    }) => {
        const [conversation] = await db
            .insert(Conversations)
            .values({
                userId,
                title,
                resourceType,
                resourceId,
            })
            .returning({ id: Conversations.id });

        return conversation;
    },
};

const authorizeRequestResource = async ({
    resourceType,
    resourceId,
    userId,
    res,
}: {
    resourceType: string;
    resourceId: string;
    userId: string;
    res: Response;
}) => {
    const authorization = await authorizeChatResource({
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
        userId,
        repository: chatResourceRepository,
    });

    if (!authorization.ok) {
        res.status(authorization.status).send({
            error: authorization.error,
        });
        return null;
    }

    return authorization;
};

const findScopedConversation = async ({
    conversationId,
    userId,
    resourceType,
    resourceId,
}: {
    conversationId: string;
    userId: string;
    resourceType: "book";
    resourceId: string;
}) => {
    const [conversation] = await db
        .select()
        .from(Conversations)
        .where(
            and(
                eq(Conversations.id, conversationId),
                eq(Conversations.userId, userId),
                eq(Conversations.resourceType, resourceType),
                eq(Conversations.resourceId, resourceId)
            )
        );

    return conversation ?? null;
};

const touchConversation = async (conversationId: string) => {
    await db
        .update(Conversations)
        .set({ lastMessageAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(Conversations.id, conversationId));
};

const loadConversationHistory = async (
    conversationId: string
): Promise<ChatMessage[]> => {
    const rows = await db
        .select({
            role: Messages.role,
            content: Messages.content,
        })
        .from(Messages)
        .where(eq(Messages.conversationId, conversationId))
        .orderBy(asc(Messages.createdAt));

    return toChatHistory(rows);
};
const resolveChatModel = (model: unknown): OpenAIChatModel | null => {
    if (model === undefined || model === null || model === "") {
        return OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL;
    }

    return isOpenAIChatModel(model) ? model : null;
};

const writeChatStatusAndEnd = (
    res: Response,
    payload: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
    res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`);
    res.write("data: [DONE]\n\n");
    res.end();
};

const streamAssistantResponse = async ({
    messages,
    res,
    trace,
    userId,
    conversationId,
    resourceType,
    resourceId,
    routeName,
    model,
    traceOpenAI,
    signal,
}: {
    messages: ChatMessage[];
    res: Response;
    trace: TraceObservation;
    userId: string;
    conversationId: string;
    resourceType: string;
    resourceId: string;
    routeName: string;
    model: OpenAIChatModel;
    traceOpenAI: boolean;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}) => {
    const openAiSpan = trace.startObservation("openai_chat_stream", {
        input: {
            model,
            temperature: OPENAI_CHAT_TEMPERATURE,
            maxTokens: OPENAI_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS,
            messageCount: messages.length,
        },
    });

    try {
        const generated = await generateBookAnswer({
            messages,
            model,
            options: {
                signal,
                ...(traceOpenAI
                    ? {
                          langfuse: {
                              userId,
                              sessionId: conversationId,
                              generationName: "openai_chat_completion",
                              tags: ["reader-api", "book-chat", routeName],
                              generationMetadata: {
                                  routeName,
                                  resourceType,
                                  resourceId,
                                  conversationId,
                                  model,
                              },
                              parentSpanContext: openAiSpan.getSpanContext(),
                          },
                      }
                    : {}),
            },
            onContent(content) {
                if (!res.writableEnded) {
                    res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ content })}\n\n`);
                }
            },
            shouldContinue: () => !res.writableEnded,
        });

        openAiSpan.update({
            ...(generated.transportWarning
                ? {
                      level: "WARNING",
                      statusMessage:
                          "Premature close after completed chat stream",
                  }
                : {}),
            output: {
                outputLength: generated.answer.length,
                finishReason: generated.finishReason,
                streamCompleted: generated.streamCompleted,
                usage: generated.usage,
                transportWarning: generated.transportWarning,
            },
        });
        return generated;
    } catch (streamError) {
        recordObservationError(
            openAiSpan,
            streamError,
            "OpenAI chat stream failed"
        );
        throw streamError;
    } finally {
        openAiSpan.end();
    }
};

const saveAssistantMessage = async (
    conversationId: string,
    content: string,
    contextSources: MessageContextSource[] | null,
    trace: TraceObservation,
    completionStatus: "complete" | "truncated" | "cancelled" | "failed",
    finishReason: string | null,
    executionMetadata: MessageExecutionMetadata
) => {
    const saveSpan = trace.startObservation("save_assistant_message", {
        input: {
            conversationId,
            responseLength: content.length,
            sourceCount: contextSources?.length ?? 0,
        },
    });

    try {
        const [message] = await db
            .insert(Messages)
            .values({
                conversationId,
                role: "assistant",
                content,
                contextSources,
                completionStatus,
                finishReason,
                executionMetadata,
            })
            .returning({ id: Messages.id });
        await touchConversation(conversationId);
        saveSpan.update({
            output: {
                saved: true,
                responseLength: content.length,
                sourceCount: contextSources?.length ?? 0,
            },
        });
        return message;
    } catch (error) {
        recordObservationError(
            saveSpan,
            error,
            "Assistant message save failed"
        );
        throw error;
    } finally {
        saveSpan.end();
    }
};

const runChatCompletion = async ({
    resourceType,
    resourceId,
    conversationId,
    userId,
    messages,
    query,
    res,
    routeName,
    model,
    highlightContext,
    trace,
    signal,
    userMessageId,
}: {
    resourceType: string;
    resourceId: string;
    conversationId: string;
    userId: string;
    messages: ChatMessage[];
    query: string;
    res: Response;
    routeName: string;
    model: OpenAIChatModel;
    highlightContext: HighlightContext | null;
    trace: TraceObservation;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    userMessageId: string;
}) => {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const retrievalQuery = buildRetrievalQuery(query, highlightContext);
    const ragResult =
        resourceType === "book"
            ? await retrieveBookContext({
                  bookId: resourceId,
                  userId,
                  messages,
                  query: retrievalQuery,
                  signal,
                  highlightContext,
                  trace,
              })
            : {
                  messages: addHighlightContextMessage(
                      messages,
                      highlightContext
                  ),
                  status: "ready" as const,
                  sources: null,
              };
    if (ragResult.status === "processing") {
        trace.setTraceIO({ output: { status: "processing" } });
        writeChatStatusAndEnd(res, {
            error: "Document context is still processing. Please try again shortly.",
            status: "processing",
        });
        return;
    }
    if (ragResult.status === "ingestion_failed") {
        trace.setTraceIO({
            output: { status: "failed", error: ragResult.error },
        });
        writeChatStatusAndEnd(res, {
            error: ragResult.error || "Document text processing failed.",
            status: "failed",
        });
        return;
    }
    if (
        ragResult.status === "not_found" ||
        ragResult.status === "retrieval_unavailable"
    ) {
        const error =
            ragResult.status === "not_found"
                ? "Book was not found."
                : "Book retrieval is temporarily unavailable.";
        trace.setTraceIO({ output: { status: ragResult.status, error } });
        writeChatStatusAndEnd(res, { error, status: ragResult.status });
        return;
    }

    const generated = await streamAssistantResponse({
        messages: ragResult.messages,
        res,
        trace,
        userId,
        conversationId,
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
        routeName,
        model,
        traceOpenAI: resourceType === "book",
        signal,
    });

    if (!res.writableEnded) {
        const completionStatus =
            generated.finishReason === "stop"
                ? "complete"
                : generated.finishReason === "length"
                  ? "truncated"
                  : "failed";
        const telemetry =
            "telemetry" in ragResult
                ? ragResult.telemetry
                : {
                      pipelineVersion: "direct-chat-v1",
                      promptVersion: "helpful-assistant-v1",
                      queryPlan: null,
                      retrieval: null,
                  };
        const executionMetadata = buildMessageExecutionMetadata({
            telemetry,
            model: generated.modelVersion,
            usage: generated.usage,
            generationDurationMs: generated.durationMs,
            totalLatencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
            langfuseTraceId: trace.traceId,
        });
        const assistantMessage = await saveAssistantMessage(
            conversationId,
            generated.answer,
            ragResult.sources,
            trace,
            completionStatus,
            generated.finishReason,
            executionMetadata
        );
        trace.setTraceIO({
            output: {
                status: "complete",
                assistantResponseLength: generated.answer.length,
                sourceCount: ragResult.sources?.length ?? 0,
                pipelineVersion: executionMetadata.pipelineVersion,
                promptVersion: executionMetadata.promptVersion,
                totalLatencyMs: executionMetadata.totalLatencyMs,
                estimatedCost: executionMetadata.generation.estimatedCost,
            },
        });
        if (ragResult.sources?.length) {
            res.write(
                `data: ${JSON.stringify({ type: "sources", sources: ragResult.sources })}\n\n`
            );
        }
        res.write(
            `data: ${JSON.stringify({ type: "terminal", status: completionStatus, finishReason: generated.finishReason })}\n\n`
        );
        res.write("data: [DONE]\n\n");
        res.end();
        if (resourceType === "book" && assistantMessage) {
            await maybeEnqueueRagRerankShadow({
                assistantMessageId: assistantMessage.id,
                userMessageId,
                conversationId,
                bookId: resourceId,
                userId,
                hasHighlightContext: Boolean(highlightContext),
            });
        }
    }
};

const runBookChatTraceIfNeeded = <T>(
    {
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
        conversationId,
        userId,
        routeName,
        messageCount,
        queryLength,
        hasHighlightContext,
    }: {
        resourceType: string;
        resourceId: string;
        conversationId: string;
        userId: string;
        routeName: string;
        messageCount: number;
        queryLength: number;
        hasHighlightContext?: boolean;
    },
    fn: (trace: TraceObservation) => T
) => {
    if (resourceType !== "book") return fn(getNoopTraceObservation());

    return withBookChatTrace(
        {
            userId,
            conversationId,
            resourceType,
            resourceId,
            routeName,
            messageCount,
            queryLength,
            hasHighlightContext,
        },
        fn
    );
};

router.post(
    "/:resourceType/:id/conversations",
    authenticate,
    chatRateLimit,
    async (req: Request, res) => {
        try {
            const { model } = req.body;
            const message = getSubmittedUserMessage(req.body);
            if (!message) {
                res.status(400).send({
                    error: "Message is required",
                });
                return;
            }
            const highlightContext = normalizeHighlightContext(
                req.body.highlightContext
            );
            const chatModel = resolveChatModel(model);
            if (!chatModel) {
                res.status(400).send({
                    error: "Unsupported chat model",
                });
                return;
            }
            const creation = await createAuthorizedChatConversation({
                resourceType: req.params.resourceType,
                resourceId: req.params.id,
                userId: req.user.id,
                title: message.substring(0, 50) + "...",
                repository: chatResourceRepository,
            });
            if (!creation.ok) {
                res.status(creation.status).send({ error: creation.error });
                return;
            }

            res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/event-stream");
            res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
            res.setHeader("Connection", "keep-alive");

            const conversation = creation.conversation;

            res.write(
                `data: ${JSON.stringify({ type: "conversation_id", conversationId: conversation.id })}\n\n`
            );

            const messages = appendSubmittedUserMessage([], message);
            const [userMessage] = await db
                .insert(Messages)
                .values(buildUserMessageInsert(conversation.id, message))
                .returning({ id: Messages.id });
            await touchConversation(conversation.id);

            const abortController = new AbortController();
            req.once("aborted", () => abortController.abort());

            await runBookChatTraceIfNeeded(
                {
                    resourceType: req.params.resourceType,
                    resourceId: req.params.id,
                    conversationId: conversation.id,
                    userId: req.user.id,
                    routeName: "create_conversation",
                    messageCount: messages.length,
                    queryLength: message.length,
                    hasHighlightContext: Boolean(highlightContext),
                },
                (trace) =>
                    runChatCompletion({
                        resourceType: req.params.resourceType,
                        resourceId: req.params.id,
                        conversationId: conversation.id,
                        userId: req.user.id,
                        messages,
                        query: message,
                        res,
                        routeName: "create_conversation",
                        model: chatModel,
                        highlightContext,
                        trace,
                        signal: abortController.signal,
                        userMessageId: userMessage.id,
                    })
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Error in chat stream", e);
            if (!res.writableEnded) {
                res.write(
                    `data: ${JSON.stringify({ error: "An error occurred" })}\n\n`
                );
                res.end();
            }
        }
    }
);

router.get(
    "/:resourceType/:id/conversations",
    authenticate,
    async (req: Request, res) => {
        try {
            const authorization = await authorizeRequestResource({
                resourceType: req.params.resourceType,
                resourceId: req.params.id,
                userId: req.user.id,
                res,
            });
            if (!authorization) return;

            const conversations = await db
                .select()
                .from(Conversations)
                .where(
                    and(
                        eq(Conversations.userId, req.user.id),
                        eq(
                            Conversations.resourceType,
                            authorization.resourceType
                        ),
                        eq(Conversations.resourceId, req.params.id)
                    )
                )
                .orderBy(desc(Conversations.lastMessageAt));
            res.status(200).send({
                conversations,
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error fetching conversations", error);
            if (!res.headersSent) {
                res.status(500).send({
                    error: "An error occurred while fetching conversations",
                });
            }
        }
    }
);

router.post(
    "/:resourceType/:rid/conversations/:cid/messages",
    authenticate,
    chatRateLimit,
    async (req, res) => {
        try {
            const {
                resourceType,
                rid: resourceId,
                cid: conversationId,
            } = req.params;
            if (
                !resourceType ||
                !resourceId ||
                !conversationId ||
                !isSupportedChatResourceType(resourceType)
            ) {
                res.status(400).send({
                    error: "Invalid request",
                });
                return;
            }

            const { model } = req.body;
            const message = getSubmittedUserMessage(req.body);
            if (!message) {
                res.status(400).send({
                    error: "Message is required",
                });
                return;
            }
            const highlightContext = normalizeHighlightContext(
                req.body.highlightContext
            );
            const chatModel = resolveChatModel(model);
            if (!chatModel) {
                res.status(400).send({
                    error: "Unsupported chat model",
                });
                return;
            }
            const authorization = await authorizeRequestResource({
                resourceType,
                resourceId,
                userId: req.user.id,

            if (!authorization) return;

            const conversation = await findScopedConversation({
                conversationId,
                userId: req.user.id,

            });

            if (!conversation) {

                    error: "Conversation not found",
                });
                return;
            }

            res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/event-stream");
            res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
            res.setHeader("Connection", "keep-alive");

            const messages = appendSubmittedUserMessage(
                await loadConversationHistory(conversationId),

            );

                    resourceId,
                    conversationId,
                    userId: req.user.id,
                    routeName: "append_message",
                    messageCount: messages.length,
                    queryLength: message.length,
                    hasHighlightContext: Boolean(highlightContext),
                },
                (trace) =>
                    runChatCompletion({
                        resourceType,
                        resourceId,
                        conversationId,
                        userId: req.user.id,
                        messages,
                        query: message,
                        res,
                        routeName: "append_message",
                        model: chatModel,
                        highlightContext,
                        trace,
                        signal: abortController.signal,
                        userMessageId: userMessage.id,
                    })
            );
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error in chat messages", error);
            if (!res.writableEnded) {
                res.write(
                    `data: ${JSON.stringify({ error: "An error occurred" })}\n\n`
                );
                res.end();
            }
        }
    }
);

import {
    getEvalThresholds,
    getJudgeMaxCases,
    getJudgeModel,
    hasLangfuseConfig,
    hasOpenAiConfig,
    shouldFailEvalCommand,
} from "./config";
import type { EvalCommand } from "./config";
import {
    computeBaselineInputHashes,
    evaluateBaselineRegression,
    loadBaselineReference,
} from "./baselineRegression";
import { loadGoldenDataset } from "./dataset";
import { runAnswerEval } from "./answerJudge";
import {
    syncReportToLangfuse,
    syncRerankComparisonToLangfuse,
} from "./langfuse";
import { runLiveRagEval } from "./liveEval";
import { createReport, summarizeExecution, writeReport } from "./report";
import { scoreRetrievalEval } from "./retrieval";
import {
    createRerankComparisonReport,
    assertRerankComparisonMatrix,
    assertPreparedRerankMatrix,
    writeRerankComparisonReport,
    writeInfrastructureFailureReport,
} from "./rerankComparison";
import { OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS } from "@reader/api/rag";

const fail = (message: string): never => {
    console.error(message);
    process.exit(1);
};

const persistAndPrint = async (report: Parameters<typeof writeReport>[0]) => {
    const paths = await writeReport(report);
    console.log(`Wrote ${paths.jsonPath}`);
    console.log(`Wrote ${paths.markdownPath}`);
};

const runRerankComparison = async () => {
    let reportWritten = false;
    try {
        if (!hasOpenAiConfig()) {
            throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY is required for live RAG evals");
        }
        const thresholds = getEvalThresholds();
        const cases = await loadGoldenDataset(undefined, "required");
        const pipelineVersions = ["baseline-rag-v1", "rerank-rag-v1"] as const;
        const expectedJudgedAnswers = assertRerankComparisonMatrix({
            cases,
            answerModels: [...OPENAI_CHAT_MODELS],
            pipelineVersions: [...pipelineVersions],
            maxJudgedAnswers: Math.min(50, getJudgeMaxCases()),
        });
        const live = await runLiveRagEval(cases, {
            pipelineVersions: [...pipelineVersions],
        });
        const baselineCases = live.cases.filter(
            (testCase) => testCase.pipelineVersion === "baseline-rag-v1"
        );
        const rerankedCases = live.cases.filter(
            (testCase) => testCase.pipelineVersion === "rerank-rag-v1"
        );
        const baselineRetrievalCases = live.retrievalCases.filter(
            (testCase) => testCase.pipelineVersion === "baseline-rag-v1"
        );
        const rerankedRetrievalCases = live.retrievalCases.filter(
            (testCase) => testCase.pipelineVersion === "rerank-rag-v1"
        );
        const generatedAnswerCount = assertPreparedRerankMatrix({
            baselineCases,
            rerankedCases,
            answerModels: live.answerModels,
            maxJudgedAnswers: Math.min(50, getJudgeMaxCases()),
        });
        if (generatedAnswerCount !== expectedJudgedAnswers) {
            throw new Error(
                "Generated rerank matrix does not match input matrix"
            );
        }
        const baselineRetrieval = scoreRetrievalEval(
            baselineRetrievalCases,
            thresholds
        );
        const rerankedRetrieval = scoreRetrievalEval(
            rerankedRetrievalCases,
            thresholds
        );
        const baselineAnswers = await runAnswerEval(baselineCases, thresholds);
        const rerankedAnswers = await runAnswerEval(rerankedCases, thresholds);
        const report = createRerankComparisonReport({
            baselineRetrieval,
            rerankedRetrieval,
            baselineAnswers,
            rerankedAnswers,
            baselineCases: baselineRetrievalCases,
            rerankedCases: rerankedRetrievalCases,
            fixtures: live.fixtures,
            ingestion: live.ingestion,
            answerModels: live.answerModels,
        });
        const paths = await writeRerankComparisonReport(report);
        reportWritten = true;
        console.log(`Wrote ${paths.jsonPath}`);
        console.log(`Wrote ${paths.markdownPath}`);
        if (hasLangfuseConfig()) {
            try {
                const result = await syncRerankComparisonToLangfuse(report);
                console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn(
                    `Langfuse comparison sync failed without changing the promotion result: ${
                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
                    }`
                );
            }
        } else {
            console.log(
                "Skipping Langfuse comparison sync: LANGFUSE_* secrets are absent."
            );
        }
        if (!report.promotionPassed) {
            throw new Error(
                `Reranking promotion gate failed: ${report.promotion.failedChecks.join(", ")}`
            );
        }
    } catch (error) {
        if (!reportWritten) {
            const { paths } = await writeInfrastructureFailureReport(error);
            console.error(`Wrote ${paths.jsonPath}`);
            console.error(`Wrote ${paths.markdownPath}`);
        }
        throw error;
    }
};

const run = async () => {
    const command = process.argv[2] as EvalCommand | "rerank" | undefined;
    if (
        command !== "live" &&
        command !== "ci" &&
        command !== "extended" &&
        command !== "rerank"
    ) {
        fail("Usage: node dist/cli.js <live|ci|extended|rerank>");
    }
    if (command === "rerank") {
        await runRerankComparison();
        return;
    }
    const evalCommand = command as EvalCommand;
    if (!hasOpenAiConfig()) {
        fail("OPENAI_API_KEY is required for live RAG evals");
    }

    const suite = evalCommand === "extended" ? "extended" : "required";
    const thresholds = getEvalThresholds();
    const cases = await loadGoldenDataset(undefined, suite);
    const live = await runLiveRagEval(cases);
    const retrieval = scoreRetrievalEval(live.retrievalCases, thresholds);
    const answers = await runAnswerEval(live.cases, thresholds);
    let report = createReport({
        answerModels: live.answerModels,
        resolvedAnswerModels: live.resolvedAnswerModels,
        judgeModel: getJudgeModel(),
        resolvedJudgeModels: [
            ...new Set(
                answers.cases.map((testCase) => testCase.resolvedJudgeModel)
            ),
        ],
        suite,
        thresholds,
        fixtures: live.fixtures,
        ingestion: live.ingestion,
        retrieval,
        answers,
        execution: summarizeExecution({ retrieval, answers }),
    });
    if (evalCommand === "ci") {
        const [reference, hashes] = await Promise.all([
            loadBaselineReference(),
            computeBaselineInputHashes(),
        ]);
        report = {
            ...report,
            regression: evaluateBaselineRegression({
                reference,
                ...hashes,
                pipelineVersions: report.execution.pipelineVersions,
                promptVersions: report.execution.promptVersions,
                answerModels: report.answerModels,
                judgeModel: report.judgeModel,
                retrieval: report.retrieval,
                answers: report.answers,
            }),
        };
    }
    await persistAndPrint(report);
    console.log(`Absolute quality passed: ${report.qualityPassed}`);
    if (report.regression) {
        console.log(
            `Baseline regression passed: ${report.regression.passed} (${report.regression.referenceVersion})`
        );
        console.log(
            `Observed known gaps: ${report.regression.observedKnownGaps.join(", ") || "none"}`
        );
        console.log(
            `Baseline improvements: ${report.regression.improvements.join(", ") || "none"}`
        );
        if (report.regression.failedChecks.length) {
            console.error(
                `Failed baseline checks: ${report.regression.failedChecks.join(", ")}`
            );
        }
    }

    if (hasLangfuseConfig()) {
        try {
            const result = await syncReportToLangfuse(report, cases);
            console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(
                `Langfuse sync failed without changing the quality result: ${
                    error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
                }`
            );
        }
    } else {
        console.log("Skipping Langfuse sync: LANGFUSE_* secrets are absent.");
    }

    if (
        shouldFailEvalCommand({
            command: evalCommand,
            qualityPassed: report.qualityPassed,
            regressionPassed: report.regression?.passed ?? null,
        })
    ) {
        fail(
            evalCommand === "ci"
                ? "Reader RAG baseline regression gate failed"
                : "Live Reader RAG quality gate failed"
        );
    }
    if (suite === "extended" && !report.qualityPassed) {
        console.warn(
            "Extended Reader RAG quality misses were reported without failing the manual workflow."
        );
    }
};

run().catch((error) => {
    fail(error instanceof Error ? error.stack || error.message : String(error));
});
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/services/BookRagService.ts">
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { createLogger } from "@reader/providers";
import { db } from "../db";
import { Books, type MessageContextSource } from "../db/schema";
import {
    buildBookContextSystemPrompt,
    type HighlightContext,
} from "./HighlightContext";
import { hybridBookSearchService } from "./HybridBookSearchService";
import {
    OpenAIService,
    resolveStreamModelVersion,
    type ChatMessage,
    type GenerateStreamResponseOptions,
    type OpenAIChatModel,
} from "./OpenAIServices";
import {
    getLangfuseCaptureConfig,
    getNoopTraceObservation,
    recordObservationError,
    snippetForLangfuse,
    type TraceObservation,
} from "../observability/langfuse";
import { getRagPipeline, type RagPipelineVersion } from "./RagPipeline";
import { getRagMinHybridScore } from "./RagRetrievalConfig";
import { retrieveRerankedEvidence } from "./RerankedRetrieval";

const log = createLogger("bookRag");

const getErrorDetail = (error: unknown) => {
    if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return String(error);
    const details = error as {
        code?: unknown;
        errno?: unknown;
        message?: unknown;
        name?: unknown;
    };

    return [details.name, details.code, details.errno, details.message]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ");
};

const isPrematureCloseError = (error: unknown) =>
    getErrorDetail(error).includes("ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE") ||
    getErrorDetail(error).includes("Premature close");

const summarizeRetrievedChunks = (
    results: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof hybridBookSearchService.search>>,
    allowSnippets = true
) => {
    const capture = getLangfuseCaptureConfig();
    return results.map((result) => {
        const snippet = allowSnippets
            ? snippetForLangfuse(result.content, capture)
            : undefined;
        return {
            id: result.id,
            chunkIndex: result.chunkIndex,
            score: result.score,
            bestRank: result.bestRank,
            ...(snippet ? { snippet } : {}),
        };
    });
};

const buildContextSources = (
    results: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof hybridBookSearchService.search>>
): MessageContextSource[] =>
    results.map((result) => ({
        id: result.id,
        chunkIndex: result.chunkIndex,
        score: result.score,
        bestRank: result.bestRank,
        ...("rerankerRank" in result
            ? { rerankerRank: result.rerankerRank as number }
            : {}),
        ...("rerankerScore" in result
            ? { rerankerScore: result.rerankerScore as number }
            : {}),
        ...("selectionReason" in result
            ? { selectionReason: result.selectionReason as string }
            : {}),
        excerpt: result.content,
        metadata: result.metadata,
    }));

export type BookContextResult = {
    messages: ChatMessage[];
    status:
        | "ready"
        | "not_found"
        | "processing"
        | "ingestion_failed"
        | "retrieval_unavailable";
    sources: MessageContextSource[] | null;
    telemetry: {
        pipelineVersion: string;
        promptVersion: string;
        queryPlan: null;
        retrieval:
            | import("../types/ragTelemetry").RagRetrievalDiagnostics
            | null;
    };
    error?: string | null;
};

export const retrieveBookEvidence = async ({
    bookId,
    userId,
    query,
    signal,
    trace = getNoopTraceObservation(),
    strict = false,
    pipelineVersion,
    includeErrorDetailInLogs = true,
    strictRerankInfrastructureErrors = false,
}: {
    bookId: string;
    userId: string;
    query: string;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    trace?: TraceObservation;
    strict?: boolean;
    pipelineVersion?: RagPipelineVersion;
    includeErrorDetailInLogs?: boolean;
    strictRerankInfrastructureErrors?: boolean;
}): Promise<
    Omit<BookContextResult, "messages"> & {
        results?: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof hybridBookSearchService.search>>;
    }
> => {
    const pipeline = getRagPipeline(pipelineVersion);
    const baseTelemetry = {
        pipelineVersion: pipeline.pipelineVersion,
        promptVersion: pipeline.promptVersion,
        queryPlan: null,
        retrieval: null,
    };
    const loadBookSpan = trace.startObservation("load_book", {
        input: { resourceType: "book", resourceId: bookId },
    });
    let book: typeof Books.$inferSelect | undefined;
    try {
        [book] = await db
            .select()
            .from(Books)
            .where(and(eq(Books.id, bookId), eq(Books.userId, userId)));
        loadBookSpan.update({
            output: {
                found: Boolean(book),
                processingStatus: book?.processingStatus,
                hasCollection: Boolean(book?.collectionName),
                collectionName: book?.collectionName,
                processingError: book?.processingError,
            },
        });
    } catch (error) {
        recordObservationError(loadBookSpan, error, "Book lookup failed");
        throw error;
    } finally {
        loadBookSpan.end();
    }

    if (!book) {
        log.warn("Book not found for RAG", { bookId, userId });
        return {
            status: "not_found",
            sources: null,
            telemetry: baseTelemetry,
        };
    }

    if (book.processingStatus === "failed") {
        return {
            status: "ingestion_failed",
            sources: null,
            telemetry: baseTelemetry,
            error: book.processingError,
        };
    }

    if (!book.collectionName) {
        return {
            status: "processing",
            sources: null,
            telemetry: baseTelemetry,
        };
    }

    try {
        const retrievalSpan = trace.startObservation("hybrid_retrieval", {
            input: {
                collectionName: book.collectionName,
                queryLength: query.length,
                lexicalLimit: 20,
                vectorLimit: 20,
                finalLimit: 5,
            },
        });
        let searchResponse:
            | Awaited<
                  ReturnType<
                      typeof hybridBookSearchService.searchWithDiagnostics
                  >
              >
            | Awaited<ReturnType<typeof retrieveRerankedEvidence>>;
        try {
            searchResponse =
                pipeline.retrievalStrategy === "reranked"
                    ? await retrieveRerankedEvidence({
                          collectionName: book.collectionName,
                          query,
                          minHybridScore: getRagMinHybridScore(),
                          signal,
                          strictInfrastructureErrors:
                              strictRerankInfrastructureErrors,
                      })
                    : await hybridBookSearchService.searchWithDiagnostics(
                          book.collectionName,
                          query,
                          {
                              minScore: getRagMinHybridScore(),
                          },
                          {
                              trace: retrievalSpan,
                              capture: getLangfuseCaptureConfig(),
                          }
                      );
            retrievalSpan.update({ output: searchResponse.diagnostics });
        } catch (error) {
            recordObservationError(
                retrievalSpan,
                error,
                "Hybrid retrieval failed"
            );
            throw error;
        } finally {
            retrievalSpan.end();
        }

        const searchResults = searchResponse.results;
        const telemetry = {
            ...baseTelemetry,
            retrieval: searchResponse.diagnostics,
        };

        if (!searchResults.length) {
            return { status: "ready", sources: null, telemetry, results: [] };
        }

        return {
            status: "ready",
            sources: buildContextSources(searchResults),
            telemetry,
            results: searchResults,
        };
    } catch (error) {
        log.error("Error retrieving book context", {
            bookId,
            collectionName: book.collectionName,
            ...(includeErrorDetailInLogs
                ? {
                      error:
                          error instanceof Error
                              ? error.message
                              : String(error),
                  }
                : {
                      errorName:
                          error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error,
                  }),
        });
        if (strict) throw error;
        return {
            status: "retrieval_unavailable",
            sources: null,
            telemetry: baseTelemetry,
            error: "Book retrieval is temporarily unavailable.",
        };
    }
};

export const retrieveBookContext = async ({
    messages,
    highlightContext = null,
    ...options
}: Parameters<typeof retrieveBookEvidence>[0] & {
    messages: ChatMessage[];
    highlightContext?: HighlightContext | null;
}): Promise<BookContextResult> => {
    const evidence = await retrieveBookEvidence(options);
    if (evidence.status !== "ready" || !evidence.results?.length) {
        return { ...evidence, messages };
    }
    const context = evidence.results
        .map((result) => result.content)
        .join("\n\n---\n\n");
    const promptSpan = (
        options.trace ?? getNoopTraceObservation()
    ).startObservation("build_rag_prompt", {
        input: {
            retrievedChunkCount: evidence.results.length,
            baseMessageCount: messages.length,
        },
    });
    promptSpan.update({
        output: {
            contextLength: context.length,
            messageCount: messages.length + 1,
            selectedChunks: summarizeRetrievedChunks(
                evidence.results,
                getRagPipeline().retrievalStrategy !== "reranked"
            ),
        },
    });
    promptSpan.end();
    const { results: _results, ...bookContext } = evidence;
    return {
        ...bookContext,
        messages: [
            {
                role: "system",
                content: buildBookContextSystemPrompt(
                    context,
                    highlightContext
                ),
            },
            ...messages,
        ],
    };
};

export type GeneratedBookAnswer = {
    answer: string;
    modelVersion: string;
    finishReason: string | null;
    streamCompleted: boolean;
    usage: unknown;
    durationMs: number;
    transportWarning?: string;
};

export const generateBookAnswer = async ({
    messages,
    model,
    options,
    onContent,
    shouldContinue = () => true,
    service,
}: {
    messages: ChatMessage[];
    model: OpenAIChatModel;
    options?: GenerateStreamResponseOptions;
    onContent?: (content: string) => void;
    shouldContinue?: () => boolean;
    service?: OpenAIService;
}): Promise<GeneratedBookAnswer> => {
    const activeService = service ?? new OpenAIService();
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    let answer = "";
    let modelVersion: string = model;
    let streamCompleted = false;
    let finishReason: string | null = null;
    let usage: unknown;

    try {
        const textStream = await activeService.generateStreamResponse(
            messages,
            undefined,
            { ...options, model }
        );

        for await (const chunk of textStream) {
            if (!shouldContinue()) break;
            modelVersion = resolveStreamModelVersion(modelVersion, chunk.model);
            const choice = chunk.choices[0];
            if (choice?.finish_reason) finishReason = choice.finish_reason;
            if (choice?.finish_reason === "stop") streamCompleted = true;
            if ("usage" in chunk && chunk.usage) usage = chunk.usage;
            const content = choice?.delta?.content || "";
            answer += content;
            onContent?.(content);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        if (!streamCompleted || !isPrematureCloseError(error)) throw error;

        return {
            answer,
            modelVersion,
            finishReason,
            streamCompleted,
            usage,
            durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
            transportWarning: getErrorDetail(error),
        };
    }

    return {
        answer,
        modelVersion,
        finishReason,
        streamCompleted,
        usage,
        durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
    };
};
</file>

import {
    OpenAIChatReranker,
    RERANKER_MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARACTERS,
    RERANKER_MODEL,
    RERANKER_PROMPT_VERSION,
    createLogger,
    type BookSearchChunk,
    type HybridBookSearchService,
    type HybridSearchDiagnostics,
    type RankedSearchResult,
    type RerankerProvider,
} from "@reader/providers";
import { estimateModelCost, normalizeModelUsage } from "./AiUsage";
import { bookSearchChunkStore } from "./BookSearchChunkStore";
import { hybridBookSearchService } from "./HybridBookSearchService";
import { getRagMinHybridScore } from "./RagRetrievalConfig";
import type {
    RerankedCandidateDiagnostic,
    RerankedRetrievalDiagnostics,
} from "../types/ragTelemetry";

const log = createLogger("rerankedRetrieval");

export const RERANK_FIRST_STAGE_LIMIT = 20;
export const RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT = 5;
export const RERANK_CANDIDATE_LIMIT = 30;
export const BASELINE_MIN_HYBRID_SCORE = 0.03;
export const MMR_RELEVANCE_WEIGHT = 0.8;
export const MMR_DIVERSITY_WEIGHT = 0.2;

export type SelectedRerankedResult = RankedSearchResult & {
    rerankerRank: number;
    rerankerScore: number;
    selectionReason: string;
};

type Candidate = RankedSearchResult & {
    firstStageRank: number;
    origin: "first_stage" | "neighbor";
    neighborOf?: string;
};

const isSameChapter = (left: BookSearchChunk, right: RankedSearchResult) => {
    if (
        left.metadata?.chapterIndex !== undefined &&
        right.metadata?.chapterIndex !== undefined
    ) {
        return left.metadata.chapterIndex === right.metadata.chapterIndex;
    }
    return Boolean(
        left.metadata?.chapterTitle &&
            left.metadata.chapterTitle === right.metadata?.chapterTitle
    );
};

const isSamePage = (left: BookSearchChunk, right: RankedSearchResult) =>
    left.metadata?.pageNumber !== undefined &&
    left.metadata.pageNumber === right.metadata?.pageNumber;

export const deriveBaselineResults = (
    broadResults: RankedSearchResult[],
    mode: HybridSearchDiagnostics["mode"],
    minHybridScore: number
) =>
    (mode === "hybrid"
        ? broadResults.filter((result) => result.score >= minHybridScore)
        : broadResults
    ).slice(0, RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT);

export const expandRerankCandidates = (
    firstStage: RankedSearchResult[],
    chunks: BookSearchChunk[]
): Candidate[] => {
    const candidates: Candidate[] = firstStage.map((result, index) => ({
        ...result,
        firstStageRank: index + 1,
        origin: "first_stage",
    }));
    const seen = new Set(candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.id));
    const chunksByIndex = new Map(
        chunks.map((chunk) => [chunk.chunkIndex, chunk])
    );

    for (const [seedIndex, seed] of firstStage.slice(0, 5).entries()) {
        for (const chunkIndex of [seed.chunkIndex - 1, seed.chunkIndex + 1]) {
            const neighbor = chunksByIndex.get(chunkIndex);
            if (
                !neighbor ||
                seen.has(neighbor.id) ||
                (!isSameChapter(neighbor, seed) && !isSamePage(neighbor, seed))
            ) {
                continue;
            }
            candidates.push({
                id: neighbor.id,
                content: neighbor.content,
                chunkIndex: neighbor.chunkIndex,
                metadata: neighbor.metadata,
                score: 0,
                bestRank: seed.bestRank,
                firstStageRank: seedIndex + 1,
                origin: "neighbor",
                neighborOf: seed.id,
            });
            seen.add(neighbor.id);
            if (candidates.length >= RERANK_CANDIDATE_LIMIT) return candidates;
        }
    }
    return candidates.slice(0, RERANK_CANDIDATE_LIMIT);
};

export const buildBoundedRerankerDocuments = (candidates: Candidate[]) => {
    let remaining = RERANKER_MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARACTERS;
    return candidates.map((candidate, index) => {
        const remainingCandidates = candidates.length - index;
        const characterBudget = Math.floor(remaining / remainingCandidates);
        const content = candidate.content.slice(0, characterBudget);
        remaining -= content.length;
        return { id: candidate.id, content };
    });
};

export const classifyRerankerFallback = (error: unknown) => {
    const detail =
        error instanceof Error
            ? `${error.name} ${error.message}`.toLowerCase()
            : String(error).toLowerCase();
    if (
        detail.includes("timeout") ||
        detail.includes("timed out") ||
        detail.includes("aborterror")
    ) {
        return "timeout";
    }
    if (detail.includes("refus")) return "refusal";
    if (
        detail.includes("invalid json") ||
        detail.includes("response incomplete") ||
        detail.includes("schema") ||
        detail.includes("ranking") ||
        detail.includes("candidate exactly once")
    ) {
        return "invalid_or_incomplete_ranking";
    }
    return "provider_error";
};

const SAFE_RERANKER_ERROR_PREFIXES = [
    "Reranker returned",
    "Reranker response",
    "Reranker ranking",
    "Reranker refused",
    "Reranker requires",
    "Reranker documents exceed",
    "Reranker candidate IDs",
    "Reranker topN",
] as const;

export const describeRerankerError = (error: unknown) => {
    const record =
        error && typeof error === "object"
            ? (error as Record<string, unknown>)
            : undefined;
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "";
    const safeDetail = SAFE_RERANKER_ERROR_PREFIXES.some((prefix) =>
        message.startsWith(prefix)
    )
        ? message
        : null;
    const stringField = (field: string) =>
        typeof record?.[field] === "string" ? record[field] : null;
    const numericField = (field: string) =>
        typeof record?.[field] === "number" ? record[field] : null;

    return {
        errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error,
        errorDetail: safeDetail,
        providerStatus: numericField("status"),
        providerCode: stringField("code"),
        providerType: stringField("type"),
        providerRequestId:
            stringField("request_id") ?? stringField("requestId"),
    };
};

const wordTrigrams = (text: string) => {
    const words = text
        .normalize("NFKC")
        .toLowerCase()
        .match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu);
    const trigrams = new Set<string>();
    if (!words) return trigrams;
    for (let index = 0; index <= words.length - 3; index += 1) {
        trigrams.add(words.slice(index, index + 3).join(" "));
    }
    return trigrams;
};

export const wordTrigramJaccard = (left: string, right: string) => {
    const leftSet = wordTrigrams(left);
    const rightSet = wordTrigrams(right);
    if (!leftSet.size && !rightSet.size) return left === right ? 1 : 0;
    let intersection = 0;
    for (const trigram of leftSet) {
        if (rightSet.has(trigram)) intersection += 1;
    }
    return intersection / (leftSet.size + rightSet.size - intersection);
};

export const maxWordTrigramSimilarity = (
    results: Array<Pick<RankedSearchResult, "content">>
) => {
    let maximum = 0;
    for (let left = 0; left < results.length; left += 1) {
        for (let right = left + 1; right < results.length; right += 1) {
            maximum = Math.max(
                maximum,
                wordTrigramJaccard(
                    results[left].content,
                    results[right].content
                )
            );
        }
    }
    return maximum;
};

export const selectWithDeterministicMmr = (
    candidates: Candidate[],
    scores: Map<string, number>,
    limit = RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT,
    maxAllowedSimilarity = 1
): SelectedRerankedResult[] => {
    const rerankerOrder = [...candidates].sort((left, right) => {
        const scoreDelta =
            (scores.get(right.id) ?? 0) - (scores.get(left.id) ?? 0);
        if (scoreDelta) return scoreDelta;
        if (left.firstStageRank !== right.firstStageRank) {
            return left.firstStageRank - right.firstStageRank;
        }
        return left.chunkIndex - right.chunkIndex;
    });
    const rankById = new Map(
        rerankerOrder.map((candidate, index) => [candidate.id, index + 1])
    );
    const remaining = new Map(
        candidates.map((candidate) => [candidate.id, candidate])
    );
    const selected: SelectedRerankedResult[] = [];

    while (selected.length < limit && remaining.size) {
        const ranked = [...remaining.values()]
            .map((candidate) => {
                const maxSimilarity = selected.length
                    ? Math.max(
                          ...selected.map((chosen) =>
                              wordTrigramJaccard(
                                  candidate.content,
                                  chosen.content
                              )
                          )
                      )
                    : 0;
                const relevance = scores.get(candidate.id) ?? 0;
                return {
                    candidate,
                    relevance,
                    maxSimilarity,
                    mmr:
                        MMR_RELEVANCE_WEIGHT * relevance -
                        MMR_DIVERSITY_WEIGHT * maxSimilarity,
                };
            })
            .filter(
                ({ maxSimilarity }) =>
                    maxSimilarity <= maxAllowedSimilarity + Number.EPSILON
            )
            .sort((left, right) => {
                if (right.mmr !== left.mmr) return right.mmr - left.mmr;
                if (
                    left.candidate.firstStageRank !==
                    right.candidate.firstStageRank
                ) {
                    return (
                        left.candidate.firstStageRank -
                        right.candidate.firstStageRank
                    );
                }
                return left.candidate.chunkIndex - right.candidate.chunkIndex;
            });
        const winner = ranked[0];
        if (!winner) break;
        remaining.delete(winner.candidate.id);
        selected.push({
            ...winner.candidate,
            rerankerRank: rankById.get(winner.candidate.id)!,
            rerankerScore: winner.relevance,
            selectionReason: `mmr=${winner.mmr.toFixed(6)};maxWordTrigramJaccard=${winner.maxSimilarity.toFixed(6)}`,
        });
    }
    return selected;
};

export const selectDiversityGuardedMmr = (
    candidates: Candidate[],
    scores: Map<string, number>,
    maxAllowedSimilarity: number,
    limit = RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT
) => {
    const targetResultCount = Math.min(limit, candidates.length);
    if (!targetResultCount) return [];

    let best:
        | {
              candidates: Candidate[];
              maxSimilarity: number;
              relevance: number;
              stableRanks: number[];
          }
        | undefined;
    const selected: Candidate[] = [];
    const similarityByPair = new Map<string, number>();
    const pairKey = (left: Candidate, right: Candidate) =>
        left.id < right.id
            ? `${left.id}\u0000${right.id}`
            : `${right.id}\u0000${left.id}`;
    for (let left = 0; left < candidates.length; left += 1) {
        for (let right = left + 1; right < candidates.length; right += 1) {
            similarityByPair.set(
                pairKey(candidates[left], candidates[right]),
                wordTrigramJaccard(
                    candidates[left].content,
                    candidates[right].content
                )
            );
        }
    }

    const selectedMaxSimilarity = () => {
        let maximum = 0;
        for (let left = 0; left < selected.length; left += 1) {
            for (let right = left + 1; right < selected.length; right += 1) {
                maximum = Math.max(
                    maximum,
                    similarityByPair.get(
                        pairKey(selected[left], selected[right])
                    ) ?? 0
                );
            }
        }
        return maximum;
    };

    const isBetter = (candidate: NonNullable<typeof best>) => {
        if (!best) return true;
        const candidateWithinCeiling =
            candidate.maxSimilarity <=
            maxAllowedSimilarity + Number.EPSILON;
        const bestWithinCeiling =
            best.maxSimilarity <= maxAllowedSimilarity + Number.EPSILON;
        if (candidateWithinCeiling !== bestWithinCeiling) {
            return candidateWithinCeiling;
        }
        if (
            !candidateWithinCeiling &&
            candidate.maxSimilarity !== best.maxSimilarity
        ) {
            return candidate.maxSimilarity < best.maxSimilarity;
        }
        if (candidate.relevance !== best.relevance) {
            return candidate.relevance > best.relevance;
        }
        for (let index = 0; index < candidate.stableRanks.length; index += 1) {
            if (candidate.stableRanks[index] !== best.stableRanks[index]) {
                return candidate.stableRanks[index] < best.stableRanks[index];
            }
        }
        return false;
    };

    const considerSelection = () => {
        const stableCandidates = [...selected].sort((left, right) => {
            if (left.firstStageRank !== right.firstStageRank) {
                return left.firstStageRank - right.firstStageRank;
            }
            return left.chunkIndex - right.chunkIndex;
        });
        const candidate = {
            candidates: [...selected],
            maxSimilarity: selectedMaxSimilarity(),
            relevance: selected.reduce(
                (total, result) => total + (scores.get(result.id) ?? 0),
                0
            ),
            stableRanks: stableCandidates.flatMap((result) => [
                result.firstStageRank,
                result.chunkIndex,
            ]),
        };
        if (isBetter(candidate)) best = candidate;
    };

    const visit = (startIndex: number) => {
        if (selected.length === targetResultCount) {
            considerSelection();
            return;
        }
        const remainingNeeded = targetResultCount - selected.length;
        for (
            let index = startIndex;
            index <= candidates.length - remainingNeeded;
            index += 1
        ) {
            selected.push(candidates[index]);
            visit(index + 1);
            selected.pop();
        }
    };

    visit(0);
    return selectWithDeterministicMmr(
        best?.candidates ?? candidates,
        scores,
        targetResultCount
    );
};

const diagnosticCandidates = (
    candidates: Candidate[]
): RerankedCandidateDiagnostic[] =>
    candidates.map((candidate) => ({
        id: candidate.id,
        firstStageRank: candidate.firstStageRank,
        chunkIndex: candidate.chunkIndex,
        origin: candidate.origin,
        ...(candidate.neighborOf ? { neighborOf: candidate.neighborOf } : {}),
    }));

const baselineDiagnostics = (
    diagnostics: HybridSearchDiagnostics,
    baseline: RankedSearchResult[]
): HybridSearchDiagnostics => ({
    ...diagnostics,
    selectedCandidates: baseline.map((result, index) => ({
        id: result.id,
        rank: index + 1,
        score: result.score,
    })),
});

export const retrieveRerankedEvidence = async ({
    collectionName,
    query,
    minHybridScore = getRagMinHybridScore(),
    signal,
    searchService = hybridBookSearchService,
    chunkReader = bookSearchChunkStore,
    reranker,
    strictInfrastructureErrors = false,
}: {
    collectionName: string;
    query: string;
    minHybridScore?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    searchService?: Pick<HybridBookSearchService, "searchWithDiagnostics">;
    chunkReader?: {
        getCollectionChunks(name: string): Promise<BookSearchChunk[]>;
    };
    reranker?: RerankerProvider;
    strictInfrastructureErrors?: boolean;
}): Promise<{
    results: Array<RankedSearchResult | SelectedRerankedResult>;
    diagnostics: RerankedRetrievalDiagnostics;
}> => {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const broad = await searchService.searchWithDiagnostics(
        collectionName,
        query,
        {
            lexicalLimit: RERANK_FIRST_STAGE_LIMIT,
            vectorLimit: RERANK_FIRST_STAGE_LIMIT,
            finalLimit: RERANK_FIRST_STAGE_LIMIT,
            minScore: 0,
        }
    );
    const baseline = deriveBaselineResults(
        broad.results,
        broad.diagnostics.mode,
        minHybridScore
    );
    const firstStage = baselineDiagnostics(broad.diagnostics, baseline);
    const makeFallback = (
        status: "skipped" | "fallback",
        fallbackReason: string,
        rerankerDurationMs = 0
    ) => ({
        results: baseline,
        diagnostics: {
            mode: "reranked" as const,
            durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
            firstStage,
            firstStageCandidates: broad.results.map((result, index) => ({
                id: result.id,
                firstStageRank: index + 1,
                chunkIndex: result.chunkIndex,
                origin: "first_stage" as const,
            })),
            finalCandidates: baseline.map((result, index) => ({
                id: result.id,
                rank: index + 1,
                firstStageRank:
                    broad.results.findIndex(
                        (candidate) => candidate.id === result.id
                    ) + 1,
                chunkIndex: result.chunkIndex,
                origin: "first_stage" as const,
                selectionReason: "exact_baseline_fallback",
                maxWordTrigramJaccard: 0,
            })),
            reranker: {
                requestedModel: RERANKER_MODEL,
                resolvedModel: null,
                promptVersion: RERANKER_PROMPT_VERSION,
                status,
                durationMs: rerankerDurationMs,
                usage: null,
                estimatedCost: null,
                fallbackReason,
            },
            diversity: { maxWordTrigramJaccard: 0 },
        },
    });

    if (broad.diagnostics.mode === "hybrid" && !baseline.length) {
        return makeFallback("skipped", "no_baseline_eligible_hybrid_seed");
    }
    if (!broad.results.length) return makeFallback("skipped", "no_candidates");

    let candidates: Candidate[];
    let boundedDocuments: ReturnType<typeof buildBoundedRerankerDocuments>;
    try {
        const chunks = await chunkReader.getCollectionChunks(collectionName);
        candidates = expandRerankCandidates(broad.results, chunks);
        boundedDocuments = buildBoundedRerankerDocuments(candidates);
    } catch (error) {
        if (strictInfrastructureErrors) throw error;
        log.warn(
            "Reranker candidate preparation failed; returning exact baseline evidence",
            {
                requestedModel: RERANKER_MODEL,
                promptVersion: RERANKER_PROMPT_VERSION,
                errorName:
                    error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error,
            }
        );
        return makeFallback("fallback", "provider_error");
    }

    let rerankerStartedAt: number | null = null;
    const rerankerCandidateCount = boundedDocuments.length;
    const rerankerDocumentCharacters = boundedDocuments.reduce(
        (total, document) => total + document.content.length,
        0
    );
    try {
        const activeReranker = reranker ?? new OpenAIChatReranker();
        rerankerStartedAt = Date.now();
        const reranked = await activeReranker.rerank({
            query,
            documents: boundedDocuments,
            topN: boundedDocuments.length,
            signal,
        });
        const scores = new Map(
            reranked.rankings.map((ranking) => [ranking.id, ranking.score])
        );
        const ranks = new Map(
            reranked.rankings.map((ranking) => [ranking.id, ranking.rank])
        );
        const targetResultCount = Math.min(
            RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT,
            candidates.length
        );
        const baselineMaxSimilarity = maxWordTrigramSimilarity(baseline);
        let results = selectWithDeterministicMmr(candidates, scores).map(
            (result) => ({
                ...result,
                rerankerRank: ranks.get(result.id) ?? result.rerankerRank,
            })
        );
        if (
            maxWordTrigramSimilarity(results) >
            baselineMaxSimilarity + Number.EPSILON
        ) {
            const guarded = selectDiversityGuardedMmr(
                candidates,
                scores,
                baselineMaxSimilarity,
                RERANK_FINAL_LIMIT
            );
            results = guarded.map((result) => ({
                ...result,
                rerankerRank: ranks.get(result.id) ?? result.rerankerRank,
                selectionReason: `diversity_guard;${result.selectionReason}`,
            }));
        }
        const finalCandidates = results.map((result, index) => {
            const source = candidates.find(
                (candidate) => candidate.id === result.id
            )!;
            const previous = results.slice(0, index);
            const maxSimilarity = previous.length
                ? Math.max(
                      ...previous.map((candidate) =>
                          wordTrigramJaccard(result.content, candidate.content)
                      )
                  )
                : 0;
            return {
                id: result.id,
                rank: index + 1,
                firstStageRank: source.firstStageRank,
                chunkIndex: result.chunkIndex,
                origin: source.origin,
                ...(source.neighborOf ? { neighborOf: source.neighborOf } : {}),
                rerankerRank: result.rerankerRank,
                rerankerScore: result.rerankerScore,
                selectionReason: result.selectionReason,
                maxWordTrigramJaccard: maxSimilarity,
            };
        });
        const maxSimilarity = maxWordTrigramSimilarity(results);
        const usage = normalizeModelUsage(reranked.usage);
        return {
            results,
            diagnostics: {
                mode: "reranked",
                durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
                firstStage,
                firstStageCandidates: diagnosticCandidates(candidates),
                finalCandidates,
                reranker: {
                    requestedModel: reranked.requestedModel,
                    resolvedModel: reranked.resolvedModel,
                    promptVersion: RERANKER_PROMPT_VERSION,
                    status: "success",
                    durationMs: reranked.durationMs,
                    usage,
                    estimatedCost: estimateModelCost(
                        reranked.resolvedModel,
                        usage
                    ),
                    fallbackReason: null,
                },
                diversity: { maxWordTrigramJaccard: maxSimilarity },
            },
        };
    } catch (error) {
        const fallbackReason = classifyRerankerFallback(error);
        const rerankerDurationMs =
            rerankerStartedAt === null ? 0 : Date.now() - rerankerStartedAt;
        log.warn("Reranker failed; returning exact baseline evidence", {
            fallbackReason,
            requestedModel: RERANKER_MODEL,
            promptVersion: RERANKER_PROMPT_VERSION,
            durationMs: rerankerDurationMs,
            candidateCount: rerankerCandidateCount,
            documentCharacters: rerankerDocumentCharacters,
            callerAborted: signal?.aborted ?? false,
            ...describeRerankerError(error),
        });
        return makeFallback("fallback", fallbackReason, rerankerDurationMs);
    }
};
</file>

<file path="apps/api/test/rerankedRetrieval.test.ts">
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import type {
    BookSearchChunk,
    HybridSearchDiagnostics,
    RankedSearchResult,
    RerankerProvider,
} from "@reader/providers";
import {
    deriveBaselineResults,
    expandRerankCandidates,
    buildBoundedRerankerDocuments,
    classifyRerankerFallback,
    describeRerankerError,
    maxWordTrigramSimilarity,
    retrieveRerankedEvidence,
    selectDiversityGuardedMmr,
    selectWithDeterministicMmr,
    wordTrigramJaccard,
} from "../src/services/RerankedRetrieval";

const result = (
    id: string,
    chunkIndex: number,
    score: number,
    content = id
): RankedSearchResult => ({
    id,
    chunkIndex,
    score,
    bestRank: chunkIndex + 1,
    content,
    metadata: { chapterIndex: 1, pageNumber: chunkIndex + 1 },
});

const diagnostics = (
    mode: HybridSearchDiagnostics["mode"]
): HybridSearchDiagnostics => ({
    mode,
    durationMs: 2,
    lexicalCandidates: [],
    vectorCandidates: [],
    selectedCandidates: [],
});

test("derives the exact hybrid and vector-only top-five baselines", () => {
    const candidates = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) =>
        result(
            `chunk-${index}`,
            index,
            index === 1 ? 0.029 : 0.04 - index / 1000
        )
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
        deriveBaselineResults(candidates, "hybrid", 0.03).map(
            (item) => item.id
        ),
        ["chunk-0", "chunk-2", "chunk-3", "chunk-4", "chunk-5"]
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
        deriveBaselineResults(candidates, "vector_only", 0.03).map(
            (item) => item.id
        ),
        candidates.slice(0, 5).map((item) => item.id)
    );
});

test("adds adjacent same-chapter or same-page neighbors and deduplicates them", () => {
    const firstStage = [result("chunk-2", 2, 0.04)];
    const chunks: BookSearchChunk[] = [1, 2, 3, 4].map((chunkIndex) => ({
        id: `chunk-${chunkIndex}`,
        collectionName: "book",
        chunkIndex,
        content: `content-${chunkIndex}`,
        metadata: {

        },
    }));
    const expanded = expandRerankCandidates(firstStage, chunks);
    assert.deepEqual(
