      Name: reader-prod-web-alb
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Subnets:
        - !Select [0, !Ref PublicSubnetIds]
        - !Select [1, !Ref PublicSubnetIds]
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref WebAlbSecurityGroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-web-alb

  ApiTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: reader-prod-api-tg
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 3000
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-api-tg

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: reader-prod-web-tg
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 3000
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckPath: /
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200-399"
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-web-tg

  ApiHttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApiLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: "443"
            StatusCode: HTTP_301

  ApiHttpsListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApiLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTPS
      Port: 443
      Certificates:
        - CertificateArn: !Ref ApiCertificateArn
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ApiTargetGroup

  WebHttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref WebLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: "443"
            StatusCode: HTTP_301

  WebHttpsListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref WebLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTPS
      Port: 443
      Certificates:
        - CertificateArn: !Ref WebCertificateArn
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: reader-prod
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod

  ApiTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: reader-prod-api
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "2048"
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: api
          Image: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/reader-api:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 3000
              HostPort: 3000
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: api-3000
              AppProtocol: http
          Environment:
            - Name: NODE_ENV
              Value: production
            - Name: CHROMA_URL
              Value: http://chroma.reader-prod.local:8000
            - Name: PORT
              Value: "3000"
            - Name: STORAGE_DRIVER
              Value: s3
            - Name: FRONTEND_URL
              Value: !Ref FrontendUrl
            - Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
              Value: !Ref GoogleClientId
            - Name: S3_BUCKET_NAME
              Value: !Ref UploadsBucketName
            - Name: S3_REGION
              Value: !Ref AWS::Region
            - Name: LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE
              Value: !Ref LangfuseSampleRate
            - Name: LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_CONTENT
              Value: !Ref LangfuseCaptureContent
            - Name: LANGFUSE_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS
              Value: !Sub "${LangfuseMaxCaptureChars}"
            - Name: RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE
              Value: !Sub "${RagRerankShadowSampleRate}"
            - !If
              - HasLangfusePublicKey
              - Name: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
                Value: !Ref LangfusePublicKey
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !If
              - HasLangfuseBaseUrl
              - Name: LANGFUSE_BASE_URL
                Value: !Ref LangfuseBaseUrl
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          Secrets:
            - Name: DATABASE_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref DatabaseUrlSecretArn
            - Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
              ValueFrom: !Ref GoogleClientSecretSecretArn
            - Name: JWT_SECRET
              ValueFrom: !Ref JwtSecretArn
            - Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
              ValueFrom: !Ref OpenAiApiKeySecretArn
            - Name: REDIS_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref RedisUrlSecretArn
            - Name: CHROMA_CLIENT_AUTH_CREDENTIALS
              ValueFrom: !Ref ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretArn
            - !If
              - HasLangfuseSecretKey
              - Name: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
                ValueFrom: !Ref LangfuseSecretKeySecretArn
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: /ecs/reader-prod/api
              awslogs-region: us-east-1
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-api

  WorkerTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: reader-prod-worker
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "2048"
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt WorkerTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: worker
          Image: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/reader-worker:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              HostPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: worker-80-tcp
              AppProtocol: http
          Environment:
            - Name: VECTOR_STORE_BATCH_SIZE
              Value: "100"
            - Name: STORAGE_DRIVER
              Value: s3
            - Name: VECTOR_STORE_BATCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS
              Value: "1000"
            - Name: NODE_ENV
              Value: production
            - Name: CHROMA_URL
              Value: http://chroma.reader-prod.local:8000
            - Name: VECTOR_STORE_CONCURRENT_BATCHES
              Value: "5"
            - Name: VECTOR_STORE_BATCH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
              Value: "3"
            - Name: S3_BUCKET_NAME
              Value: !Ref UploadsBucketName
            - Name: S3_REGION
              Value: !Ref AWS::Region
            - Name: RAG_RERANK_SHADOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
              Value: !Sub "${RagRerankShadowRateLimitPerMinute}"
            - Name: LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE
              Value: !Ref LangfuseSampleRate
            - Name: LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_CONTENT
              Value: metadata
            - Name: LANGFUSE_MAX_CAPTURE_CHARS
              Value: !Sub "${LangfuseMaxCaptureChars}"
            - !If
              - HasLangfusePublicKey
              - Name: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
                Value: !Ref LangfusePublicKey
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !If
              - HasLangfuseBaseUrl
              - Name: LANGFUSE_BASE_URL
                Value: !Ref LangfuseBaseUrl
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          Secrets:
            - Name: DATABASE_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref DatabaseUrlSecretArn
            - Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
              ValueFrom: !Ref OpenAiApiKeySecretArn
            - Name: REDIS_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref RedisUrlSecretArn
            - Name: CHROMA_CLIENT_AUTH_CREDENTIALS
              ValueFrom: !Ref ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretArn
            - !If
              - HasLangfuseSecretKey
              - Name: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
                ValueFrom: !Ref LangfuseSecretKeySecretArn
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: /ecs/reader-prod/worker
              awslogs-region: us-east-1
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-worker

  WebTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: reader-prod-web
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "2048"
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: web
          Image: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/reader-web:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 3000
              HostPort: 3000
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: web-3000
              AppProtocol: http
          Environment:
            - Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
              Value: !Ref GoogleClientId
            - Name: NODE_ENV
              Value: production
            - Name: PORT
              Value: "3000"
            - Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
              Value: !Sub https://${ApiLoadBalancer.DNSName}
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: /ecs/reader-prod/web
              awslogs-region: us-east-1
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-web

  ChromaTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: reader-prod-chroma
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "2048"
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      Volumes:
        - Name: chroma-data
          EFSVolumeConfiguration:
            FilesystemId: !Ref ChromaFileSystemId
            RootDirectory: /
            TransitEncryption: ENABLED
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: chroma
          Image: !Ref ChromaImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 8000
              HostPort: 8000
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: chroma-8000
              AppProtocol: http
          Environment:
            - Name: IS_PERSISTENT
              Value: "TRUE"
            - Name: PERSIST_DIRECTORY
              Value: /chroma/chroma
            - Name: CHROMA_SERVER_AUTHN_PROVIDER
              Value: chromadb.auth.basic_authn.BasicAuthenticationServerProvider
          Secrets:
            - Name: CHROMA_SERVER_AUTHN_CREDENTIALS
              ValueFrom: !Ref ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretArn
          MountPoints:
            - SourceVolume: chroma-data
              ContainerPath: /chroma/chroma
              ReadOnly: false
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: /ecs/reader-prod/chroma
              awslogs-region: us-east-1
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-chroma

  MigrationTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: reader-prod-migration
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "2048"
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: migration
          Image: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/reader-api:latest
          Essential: true
          Command:
            - pnpm
            - exec
            - drizzle-kit
            - migrate
            - --config
            - drizzle.config.ts
          Environment:
            - Name: NODE_ENV
              Value: production
            - Name: PORT
              Value: "3000"
            - Name: CHROMA_URL
              Value: http://chroma.reader-prod.local:8000
            - Name: STORAGE_DRIVER
              Value: s3
            - Name: FRONTEND_URL
              Value: !Ref FrontendUrl
            - Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
              Value: !Ref GoogleClientId
            - Name: S3_BUCKET_NAME
              Value: !Ref UploadsBucketName
            - Name: S3_REGION
              Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          Secrets:
            - Name: DATABASE_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref DatabaseUrlSecretArn
            - Name: REDIS_URL
              ValueFrom: !Ref RedisUrlSecretArn
            - Name: JWT_SECRET
              ValueFrom: !Ref JwtSecretArn
            - Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
              ValueFrom: !Ref OpenAiApiKeySecretArn
            - Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
              ValueFrom: !Ref GoogleClientSecretSecretArn
            - Name: CHROMA_CLIENT_AUTH_CREDENTIALS
              ValueFrom: !Ref ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretArn
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: /ecs/reader-prod/migration
              awslogs-region: us-east-1
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-migration

  ApiService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ApiHttpListener
      - ApiHttpsListener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: reader-prod-api
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref ApiDesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ApiTaskDefinition
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
            - !Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsTasksSecurityGroupId
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ApiTargetGroup
          ContainerName: api
          ContainerPort: 3000
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-api

  WorkerService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: reader-prod-worker
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref WorkerDesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref WorkerTaskDefinition
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
            - !Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsTasksSecurityGroupId
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-worker

  WebService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - WebHttpListener
      - WebHttpsListener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: reader-prod-web
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref WebDesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref WebTaskDefinition
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
            - !Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref WebTaskSecurityGroupId
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup
          ContainerName: web
          ContainerPort: 3000
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-web

  ChromaService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: reader-prod-chroma
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref ChromaDesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ChromaTaskDefinition
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
            - !Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ChromaSecurityGroupId
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !Ref ChromaDiscoveryServiceArn
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MaximumPercent: 100
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-chroma

Outputs:
  ECSCluster:
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  ECSApiService:
    Value: reader-prod-api
  ECSWorkerService:
    Value: reader-prod-worker
  ECSWebService:
    Value: reader-prod-web
  ECSMigrationTaskDefinition:
    Value: !Ref MigrationTaskDefinition
  ApiAlbDnsName:
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLoadBalancer.DNSName
  WebAlbDnsName:
    Value: !GetAtt WebLoadBalancer.DNSName
  ApiHealthUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiLoadBalancer.DNSName}/health
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiLoadBalancer.DNSName}
  WebUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${WebLoadBalancer.DNSName}
files.infra/cloudformation/reader-prod.yaml:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Reader production infrastructure, deployable from a clean AWS account
Metadata:
  Source:
    Region: us-east-1
    Runbook: docs/aws-cloudformation-rebuild.md
    Mode: clean-account-redeployment

Parameters:
  JwtSecretValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
  OpenAiApiKeySecretValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
  LangfusePublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  LangfuseSecretKeyValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ""
  LangfuseBaseUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  LangfuseSampleRate:
    Type: String
    Default: "1"
  LangfuseCaptureContent:
    Type: String
    Default: metadata
    AllowedValues:
      - metadata
      - snippets
  LangfuseMaxCaptureChars:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 20
  RagRerankShadowSampleRate:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1
  RagRerankShadowRateLimitPerMinute:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
  GoogleClientSecretValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
  ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
  ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretValue:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
  FrontendUrl:
    Type: String
  ApiCertificateArn:
    Type: String
  WebCertificateArn:
    Type: String
  ApiDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
  WorkerDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
  WebDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
  ChromaDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    AllowedValues: [1]
  ChromaImage:
    Type: String
    Default: chromadb/chroma:1.0.15
  DatabaseDeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

Resources:
  NetworkStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: nested/network.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-network

  DataStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: nested/data.yaml
      Parameters:
        JwtSecretValue: !Ref JwtSecretValue
        OpenAiApiKeySecretValue: !Ref OpenAiApiKeySecretValue
        LangfuseSecretKeyValue: !Ref LangfuseSecretKeyValue
        GoogleClientSecretValue: !Ref GoogleClientSecretValue
        ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretValue: !Ref ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretValue
        ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretValue: !Ref ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretValue
        DatabaseDeletionProtection: !Ref DatabaseDeletionProtection
        VpcId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.VpcId
        PrivateSubnetIds: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.PrivateSubnetIds
        RdsSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.RdsSecurityGroupId
        RedisSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.RedisSecurityGroupId
        EfsSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.EfsSecurityGroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-data

  CiStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: nested/ci.yaml
      Parameters:
        DeployStackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-ci

  EcsStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    DependsOn:
      - CiStack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: nested/ecs.yaml
      Parameters:
        FrontendUrl: !Ref FrontendUrl
        ApiCertificateArn: !Ref ApiCertificateArn
        WebCertificateArn: !Ref WebCertificateArn
        GoogleClientId: !Ref GoogleClientId
        LangfusePublicKey: !Ref LangfusePublicKey
        LangfuseBaseUrl: !Ref LangfuseBaseUrl
        LangfuseSampleRate: !Ref LangfuseSampleRate
        LangfuseCaptureContent: !Ref LangfuseCaptureContent
        LangfuseMaxCaptureChars: !Ref LangfuseMaxCaptureChars
        RagRerankShadowSampleRate: !Ref RagRerankShadowSampleRate
        RagRerankShadowRateLimitPerMinute: !Ref RagRerankShadowRateLimitPerMinute
        ApiDesiredCount: !Ref ApiDesiredCount
        WorkerDesiredCount: !Ref WorkerDesiredCount
        WebDesiredCount: !Ref WebDesiredCount
        ChromaDesiredCount: !Ref ChromaDesiredCount
        ChromaImage: !Ref ChromaImage
        VpcId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.VpcId
        PublicSubnetIds: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.PublicSubnetIds
        PrivateSubnetIds: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.PrivateSubnetIds
        ApiAlbSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.ApiAlbSecurityGroupId
        WebAlbSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.WebAlbSecurityGroupId
        EcsTasksSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.EcsTasksSecurityGroupId
        WebTaskSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.WebTaskSecurityGroupId
        ChromaSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.ChromaSecurityGroupId
        UploadsBucketName: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.UploadsBucketName
        UploadsBucketArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.UploadsBucketArn
        DatabaseUrlSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.DatabaseUrlSecretArn
        RedisUrlSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.RedisUrlSecretArn
        JwtSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.JwtSecretArn
        OpenAiApiKeySecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.OpenAiApiKeySecretArn
        LangfuseSecretKeySecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.LangfuseSecretKeySecretArn
        ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.ChromaServerAuthnCredentialsSecretArn
        ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.ChromaClientAuthCredentialsSecretArn
        GoogleClientSecretSecretArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.GoogleClientSecretSecretArn
        ChromaFileSystemId: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.ChromaFileSystemId
        ChromaDiscoveryServiceArn: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.ChromaDiscoveryServiceArn
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: reader
        - Key: Name
          Value: reader-prod-ecs

Outputs:
  AWSRegion:
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  AWSAccountId:
    Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
  ECSCluster:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ECSCluster
  ECSApiService:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ECSApiService
  ECSWorkerService:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ECSWorkerService
  ECSWebService:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ECSWebService
  ECSMigrationTaskDefinition:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ECSMigrationTaskDefinition
  ECSPrivateSubnetIds:
    Value: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.PrivateSubnetIds
  ECSTaskSecurityGroupId:
    Value: !GetAtt NetworkStack.Outputs.EcsTasksSecurityGroupId
  ApiAlbDnsName:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ApiAlbDnsName
  WebAlbDnsName:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.WebAlbDnsName
  ApiHealthUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ApiHealthUrl
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.ApiBaseUrl
  NextPublicGoogleClientId:
    Value: !Ref GoogleClientId
  WebUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt EcsStack.Outputs.WebUrl
  S3BucketName:
    Value: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.UploadsBucketName
  RdsEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt DataStack.Outputs.RdsEndpoint
